Additionally, the company is involved in the ICT and sustainability business used in digital field, fine chemical, energy, and food service business, as well as cultivations and sales business. The company was formerly known as Taiyo Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2010. Taiyo Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Natoco Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells paints, inks, fine chemicals, synthetic resins, and related products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Paint Business, Specialty Chemical, and Distillation Business. The company manufactures and sells versatile paints, metal paints, and exterior and interior paints used in the industrial products to housing construction materials; and coating agents that are used to make smartphones, PCs, and other information devices, display films, and automobile interiors. It is involved in the collection, distillation, and recycling of used solvents, sale of various thinners, and collection, transport, and disposal of waste materials. The company was formerly known as Natoco Paint Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Natoco Co., Ltd. in November 1998. Natoco Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Miyoshi, Japan.

Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells organic and inorganic water-based coating materials, synthetic resin paints, inorganic coating materials, and inorganic building materials in Japan and internationally. The company is also involved in the contracting of special finishing works; and manufacture and sale of heat insulation materials, fireproof coating materials, fireproof paints, and contracting of fireproof insulation works, as well as various chemical products. In addition, the company's products include exterior finishes, top coating materials, interior finishes, roof paints, iron paints, coated flooring, rooftop waterproofing materials, base adjustment coating materials, and fireproof covering/insulation materials. The company was formerly known as Shikoku Kaken Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd. in April 1991. Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

FUNDINNO,Inc. engages in the financial instruments trading operation business in Japan. The company involved in the operation of FUNDINNO, a type 1 small-amount electronic offering business; operation of FUNDINNO PLUS+, a type 1 financial instruments business; operation of FUNDINNO MARKET and FUNDINNO MARKET PLUS+, type 1 financial instruments business; FUNDOOR and development of MUFG FUNDOOR, as well as in the provision of corporate growth support consulting and recruitment services. The company was formerly known as Japan Cloud Capital, Inc. FUNDINNO,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

DIC Corporation manufactures and sells printing inks, organic pigments, and synthetic resins worldwide. The company offers printing materials, including gravure, flexo, metal decoration, inkjet, security, jet, offset, printing plates, and news inks; packaging adhesives; multilayer films; and polystyrene products. It also provides color material products, such as organic pigments; pigments for display applications, coatings, plastics, printing inks, digital printing, color filters, and cosmetics; effect pigments; health food products; aluminum for autoclaved aerated concrete; natural blue colorants; ultrananno microalgae feed; microalgae feed; and algal-derived DHA oil products; and sun chemical pigments. The company offers display materials comprising thin-film transistor and nematic liquid crystals; performance materials, including coating, adhesives, UV-curable, waterborne, acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy, phenolic, polyester/alkyd, unsaturated polyester, and other resins, as well as sulphur chemicals, fiber and textile colorants, metal carboxylates, modifiers, alkylphenols, metal carboxylates, and surfactants; and synthetic resins for inks. It also provides acrylic, polyurethane, epoxy, phenolic, polyester / alkyd, and unsaturated polyester resins; butadiene resin latex; UV-curable resin for optical / coatings; modifiers; alkylphenols; metal carboxylates; sulfur chemicals; industrial adhesive tapes and hollow fiber membrane; polyphenylene sulfide and Functional Compounds; Textile Printing Agents / Leather Colorants; and masterbatch for fibers/films. In addition, the company offers DLP 3D printing materials, multi-functional exopolysaccharide, corporate venture capital, multifunctional robot finger, tactile sensitivity enhancer, and omnidirectional multicopter. The company was formerly known as Dainippon Ink and Chemicals, Incorporated and changed its name to DIC Corporation in April 2008. The company was founded in 1908 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

artience Co., Ltd. engages in the colorants and functional materials, polymers and coatings, printing and information, and packaging materials businesses in Japan, Europe, Asia, the Americas, and internationally. The company operates through Coloring materials and functional materials related; Polymer/coating related; Package related; and Printing and information related business segments.It offers pigments, pigment dispersions, pastes for color filter, color resists, OCF resists, color/functional masterbatches, functional compounds, paints for data recording materials, CCUS materials, CNT dispersions, inkjet inks, colorants, and plastic colorants. The company also provides pressure sensitive adhesives, laminating adhesives, hot-melt adhesives, adhesive tapes, functional film for electronics, marking films, can coatings, resins, hard coating materials, medical products, natural extracts, and coating agents. In addition, it offers gravure and flexographic inks, gravure printing systems, gravure, and flexographic plate making solutions. Further, the company provides offset inks, newspaper inks, metal decorative inks, UV curing inks, offset printing materials, printing equipment, screen inks, printing inks, and others. It serves electronics, package, optoelectronics, medical/healthcare, mobility, building materials/living space, energy, and printing markets. The company was formerly known as Toyo Ink SC Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to artience Co., Ltd. in January 2024. artience Co., Ltd. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

long_name: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd.
business_summary: Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty chemicals in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Ink Business; Chemical Products Business; Processed Products Business; and Real Estate Rental Business. The company offers offset and gravure inks, inkjet inks, paints, printing machines, and printing materials. It also engages in the manufactures and sells masterbatches and resin compounds, and uniaxially oriented film. In addition, it offers plastic meshes and packaging materials and civil engineering materials. Further, it is involved in the leasing of real estate, and sales of civil engineering and agricultural materials. Additionally, it provides dry colors; colorants for thermosetting resins; functional additives for plastics; compounds; detergents; powder resins; and functional products, such as 3D printers and radiation measurement. Tokyo Printing Ink Mfg. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1895 and is headquartered in Kita, Japan.

INTELLEX HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. engages in the real estate business in Japan. The company operates through two segments: Renovation Business Field and Solution Business Field. Its Renovation Business segment engages in the sale, rental and brokerage of used homes, renovation and interior renovation business Its Solution Business segment is involved sale, purchase and rental of income-generating real estate. It also provides real estate consulting, and hotel services. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Altech Corporation provides total staffing services in Japan and internationally. The company offers staffing solutions, including assignment/contracting in technical/administrative fields; cultivating nursing care staff, assignment of nursing care staff, and introduction of nursing care facilities to residents; and education solutions, such as working professional training and technical training for new employees and mid-career employees. It also provides software development, designing/manufacturing, and engineering solutions; agriculture staffing services; development and sales of robots; home-visit care business; design, manufacturing, and installation of plant equipment and factory equipment; installation and electric wiring for transportation systems inside clean room factories; and staff and assignment introduction, total staffing service, and technical staffing solutions. The company is also involved in consulting services related to national and local government policies, social issues, as well as accommodation, banquets, and wedding businesses. The company serves machinery manufacturing companies, electricity and precision instruments, and information processing and communication businesses, as well as listed and blue-chip companies. Altech Corporation was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Original Engineering Consultants Co., Ltd. operates as an engineering consultancy firm in Japan. The company operates through Construction Consulting and Information Processing Services segments. It offers consulting services for public works projects, such as surveys, planning, detailed design, and construction supervision for water supply and sewerage systems. The company also provides wastewater collection systems, wastewater and sludge treatment, waste management, septic tank planning, urban runoff control planning, and water related BOP business coordinating services. In addition, it offers software development and IT engineering services. The company undertakes various projects in Asia, the Pacific Islands, the Middle East, and South America. Original Engineering Consultants Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Imagineer Co.,Ltd. engages in the content business in Japan, China, and internationally. The company provides smartphone games to individual users and consumer versions of console games. It also licenses its intellectual property. The company is also involved in marketing, software planning and development, and asset management businesses. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Ichishin Holdings Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the education services business in Japan. The company offers learning support for elementary, junior high, and high school students through schools, such as Ichishin Gakuin, Kotaro Juku, and Ibarashin; and Nanacara for after-school care, and total support for cram school businesses through video lesson contents. It also operates Kirian Gakuen for elementary school entrance exams; and provides long-term care services, including home care, in-home support care, day services, dementia group homes, small-scale multi-functional in-home care, comprehensive support for people with disabilities, paid nursing homes, and caregiver training. Ichishin Holdings Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Ichikawa, Japan.

QPS Holdings Inc. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, sale, operation, management, and maintenance of satellites, satellite-mounted equipment, precision equipment, electronic equipment, ground facilities, software, and information and communication networks. It is also involved in business related to data acquired by satellites; the provision of services using artificial satellites; planning and management of research meetings, workshops, and seminars on space technology; and technical consulting, operational support, contract work, development guidance, lectures, education, and related to satellites business. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

SD ENTERTAINMENT,Inc. engages in the fitness, childcare facilities, elderly care facilities, online crane game, e-commerce, and real estate leasing businesses in Japan. The company operates through Wellness Business, Creation Business, Real estate rental business, and Other business. It operates call center, as well as sells office supplies. The company was founded in 1954 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Sanix Holdings Incorporated engages in the sanitation business primarily in Japan. The company operates through Home Sanitation Business, Establishment Sanitation Business, Solar Engineering Business, PV Business, New Power Business, and Environmental Resources Development Business segments. It provides termite control, foundation repair/house reinforcement, underfloor/ceiling ventilation system construction, and renovation services for households; building water supply and drainage facilities for buildings and condominiums, as well as pest control construction services. The company also sells and installs solar power generation systems and storage batteries for detached houses; and retails electric power to general households and corporations. In addition, the company engages in construction and maintenance of solar power generation systems for companies and corporations; and wholesale of solar power generation system equipment. Further, it processes a variety of waste liquids, such as organic waste liquids; and provides maintenance services related to environmental sanitation for detached houses, buildings, and condominiums. Sanix Holdings Incorporated was formerly known as Sanix Incorporated and changed its name to Sanix Holdings Incorporated in March 2025. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

long_name: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd.
business_summary: Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. provides general building facility maintenance services in Japan and internationally. The company develops equipment maintenance plans; maintenance and management/maintenance and renewal; diagnosis and evaluation of equipment; and validation support. It also offers radiation dose measurement; measurement of radioactive material concentration in wastewater; as well as technical training services. Nippon Air conditioning Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Oriental Land Co., Ltd. operates and manages theme parks and hotels in Japan. It operates through Theme Park and Hotels segments. The Theme Park segment operates and manages Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea theme parks. The Hotel Business segment operates and manages Tokyo Disneyland Hotel, Tokyo DisneySea Hotel MiraCosta, Disney Ambassador Hotel, Tokyo Disney Celebration Hotel, Tokyo Disney Resort Toy Story Hotel, and Tokyo DisneySea Fantasy Springs Hotel. The company also operates and manages Ikspiari, a shopping complex that includes shops and restaurants, and a cinema complex; and Disney Resort Line, a monorail connecting four stations. It is also involved in the land development and maintenance of landscaping. Oriental Land Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Urayasu, Japan.

Focus Systems Corporation provides IT services for public and private clients in Japan. It operates through Public Related Business, Enterprise Business, Wide Area Solutions Business, and Innovative Business segments. The company also engages in the service of information security products; investment, development, and acting as intermediaries for companies and venture businesses; consulting and contract computer system development; systems operation and maintenance; development and distribution of information security technology and associated products, as well as software packages; planning and production of web content; temp staffing services; and other computer-related services. In addition, it is involved in the provision of technical support services for the realization of social infrastructure systems, such as my number-related, financial, trade, air traffic control, automobile-related, and insurance and pension systems; development of communication control systems, software for information and communication devices, and embedded software; infrastructure design and construction, mainframe operations, and related services; and IoT and information products and solutions. Further, the company provides core system, computerization/efficiency, IT infrastructure, cloud/virtualization, security, and built-in technologies; and cryptography, digital watermark, beacon/directional receivers, and workflow/electronic contracts. It serves the communication, finance, social security, aviation, automobile/transportation, trade/transportation, electronic administration, and local government fields. Focus Systems Corporation was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Japan Reliance Service Corporation provides various security, building maintenance, human resource, general construction, condominium management services in Japan. It offers architectural design, reception, facility management, cleaning, temporary staffing, and nursing care services. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Duskin Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental hygiene and food businesses in Japan and internationally. It is involved in the rental and sale of cleaning and hygiene products; leasing, sale, and cleaning of uniforms; sale of natural cosmetics and health foods products; and comprehensive event support. The company offers cleaning/beautification-related items such as mats, mops, cabinet towels, and air purifiers. The company provides professional cleaning; pest control and comprehensive hygiene management; home cleaning and helper; plant and flower upkeep; and home repair services comprising fixing scratches and dents, as well as emergency locksmith service; support services for seniors; and rental and sale of assisted-living products. In addition, it operates hamburger and donut shops, and pork cutlet restaurants. Duskin Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1963 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

PARK24 Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages parking lots in Japan, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Parking Business Japan, Parking Business International, and Mobility Business. The company offers hourly parking facilities; reserved and monthly parking; parking facilities for non-passenger vehicles, including large vehicles, motorcycles, and bicycles; and overseas parking facilities, such as patrolled parking facilities, and pay and display parking services. It also provides Times CAR, a membership-based unattended rent-a-car service; Times CAR RENTAL, a rent-a-car service for passenger cars, micro-buses, and trucks; Times Club membership service for drivers; Times Business Card for corporate customers; and Times PAY, a payment service used in restaurants and retail outlets. In addition, the company offers membership-based road services; and insurance agency services comprising insurance consultation and financial planning services. PARK24 Co., Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Aisan Technology Co.,Ltd. designs, develops, distributes, and maintains CAD systems for the public survey, registration surveying, civil engineering, and construction industries in Japan. The company offers surveying system solutions comprising WingNeoINFINITY; ATM'S Home; e-collector; and LASPORT, a land system port; and AreaScan. It also provides MMS/point cloud services, which includes WingEarth, a point cloud processing tool, mobile mapping system, MMS post-processing solution, and point cloud encyclopedia. In addition, the company offers mobility solutions including high precision 3D map data and position solutions, 3D data processing software, autonomous driving system development and smart city solution, and other solutions, such as drone surveying solution, and HandzReco, a character recognition engine. Aisan Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

FALCO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., a medical service company, provides clinical testing and dispensing pharmacy services to medical institutions and companies in Japan. The company offers clinical testing services in the fields of genetic tests, biochemistry, hematology, pathology, immunology, and microbiology; and genetic testing services. It also provides medical information technology services; and develops in vitro diagnostics for unmet medical needs. In addition, the company is involved in the dispensing pharmacies and drugstores business; and development and sale of various medical chart systems, including HAYATE / NEO, a cloud-based electronic medical chart for small and medium-sized hospitals, as well as @home Dr., an electronic medical chart for bed less clinics. FALCO HOLDINGS Co., Ltd. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kawasaki Geological Engineering Co., Ltd. provides geological survey services in Japan and internationally. The company offers geological surveys, including ground analysis and evaluation, underground gas survey, indoor testing, and measurement and exploration using boreholes; maintenance services, such as survey of underground cavities and buried objects, countermeasures and design, concrete diagnosis, and asset management of anchor slopes. It also provides analysis and design comprising river embankment, levee stability analysis, and levee design, as well as groundwater analysis and landslide disaster site surveying, investigation, analysis, and design. In addition, it provides ocean, resources, and energy-related services, which include 2D and 3D sonic exploration and data processing, seabed topography and surface surveys, autonomous underwater vehicle and tethered remotely operated vehicle, submarine gravimeter, and ocean bottom microtremor array survey. Further, the company is involved in disaster prevention and mitigation, such as slope disaster and ground movement monitoring systems, disaster response, and electromagnetic and sweep source for seismic reflection surveys; and research and development comprising technology and equipment development analysis and human resource development. Kawasaki Geological Engineering Co., Ltd. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Cresco Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of information technology (IT) services and digital solutions in Japan. The company operates through the IT Service Business and Digital Solution Business segments. The IT Service Business segment offers enterprise systems, financial systems, embedded systems, AI systems, mobile systems, platforms, agile development, nearshore development, offshore development, RPA implementation support, data analytics, and UX design consulting solutions, as well as comprehensive IT planning, development, and maintenance services. The Digital Solution Business segment is involved in cloud computing, robotics, AI and data, security, and UX/UI. The IT services business segment is involved in the planning, development, and maintenance services, including consulting on enterprise systems, financial systems, embedded systems, AI systems, mobile systems, platforms, agile development, nearshore development, offshore development, RPA implementation support, data analytics, and UX design. It serves information, communications, advertising, distribution services, transportation, recruitment and staffing, public sector, resources and energy, construction and real estate, travel and hotels, medical and healthcare, banking, insurance, other, automobiles and transportation equipment, and machinery and electronics industries. Cresco Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Fuji Media Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the broadcasting activities in Japan. It operates through Media & Content, Urban Development, Hotels & Resorts, and Other segments. The Media & Content segment provides terrestrial television broadcasting, including satellite broadcasting, radio broadcasting, streaming platforms, content production, games, music, advertising, publishing, and direct marketing activities. The Urban Development, Hotels & Resorts segment develops, leases, and manages office buildings; operates commercial facilities and restaurants; sells and leases apartments; and tourism resort business that operates hotels and marine leisure facilities. The Other segment engages in IT system architecture and human resources, and overseas business development activities; the provision of market research services on media and lifestyles; and cultivation of new businesses. The company was formerly known as Fuji Television Network, Inc. Fuji Media Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Resorttrust, Inc. engages in the hotel and restaurant business in Japan. It operates through three segments: Membership business, Hotel and Restaurant business, and Medical business. The company sells loans to hotel membership purchasers, and the construction of membership-based hotels. It also operates 43 resort hotels and city hotels and 1 in Hawaii; 14 golf courses, 30 medical facilities, and 23 senior residences. In addition, the company is also involved in the operation of hotels and restaurants, hotel cleaning, and member services. insurance agency services, manufacturing and sales of hair accessories, and total beauty services. Further, it offers medical memberships, lending of money to medical membership purchasers, establishment and operation/management consulting business, medical equipment leasing business, and home care service business, as well as develops medical equipment and research equipment. The company was incorporated in 1973 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

OBIC Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides system integration, system support, and office automation services in Japan. It offers consulting and system planning, system design and analysis, program development, implementation and operational support, network security design, and other related solutions for various industries, as well as OBIC7, an enterprise resource planning solution; and education and training support services. The company also engages in the sale of personal computers, communication equipment, and other system peripherals, as well as office furniture; office planning and interior construction; network support; and business package software. It serves chemistry, steel, machinery and manufacturer, food, distribution and retail, trading company, logistics, real estate, construction work, information technology and media, finance, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Ryoyu Systems Co., Ltd. provides design, development, operation and maintenance of information and communication systems for various industries in Japan. The company offers system development services for production management systems; system maintenance/operation/monitoring services, including design of information systems and communication networks; and IT infrastructure construction services comprising planning, design, construction, and operation of IT platforms, such as computers, peripherals, network devices, and communication cables. It also provides analysis solutions, including aerodynamic/structural analysis of aircraft, rockets, and engines and mechanical devices, as well as collision/impact analysis of automobiles; CAD design services; product lifecycle management system that integrates and manages various data, processes, and resources; information security operation services; and digital technologies such as AI, IoT, big data analytics, and AR. In addition, it offers outsourcing of information processing services. The company was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

JustSystems Corporation plans, develops, and provides software and related services primarily in Japan. It provides Advanced Technology of Kana-Kanji transfer, a Japanese language input system for writing text in Japanese; SMILE ZEMI, an e-learning system for elementary school students for study using a dedicated tablet device; and JUST.SFA, a sales support tool that realizes continuous growth for organizations and individuals. The company also offers Actionista!, a suite of business intelligence tool that lets anyone perform analysis; a suite of office-compatible software, such as JUST Office, JUST Government, and JUST Police to support the input of specific Japanese names and places; and ATOK Medical, a medical dictionary that enables conversion of complex disease and pharmaceutical names. It serves individuals, private sector companies, government institutions, local municipalities, police forces, schools, and hospitals. JustSystems Corporation was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

TDC SOFT Inc. provides IT consulting services in Japan. The company provides Agile, UX design, scrum training, scaled Agile framework, security, artificial intelligence consulting, and system integration infrastructure services and solutions. It also offers SAFe, a product owner / product manager; UNIX server migration service; ASTERIA Warp, a domestic data integration tool that connects various systems in a non-coding manner; amazon web services; M-check+, a cloud application for stress check; Boomi, a low-code development platform that allows for easy data linkage and integration of all types of data; and BP-LINKS, an EdI service that makes ordering, and monthly billing and settlement paperless. In addition, the company provides HuTaCT, a human resource talent management system; Informatica, a data management platform; Trustpro, a cloud-based development framework; GitLab, a DevOps platform that allows you to manage version control, code review, and CI/CD in a single application; OpenCanvas; oracle ERP related services; PC procurement kitting service; progress corticon, Qlik sense; salesforce related services; SAP related services; total security services, Tegata; and WinActor, a software-type robot, as well as support services for Microsoft 365. Further, it offers Meeepa, an EDI service that digitizes business transactions related to outsourcing; Nenoa, a private AI appliance that includes AI chat and an AI editor that handles everything from document creation to programming; Darktrace, an enterprise security product; Styleflow, a cloud-based business process optimization system; Question Craft; Movina; and ServiceNow. TDC SOFT Inc. was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

LY Corporation engages in the online advertising and e-commerce businesses in Japan. It operates through three segments: Media Business, Commerce Business, and Strategic Business. The Media Business segment offers advertising solutions, including search ads, account advertising, display advertising, and various digital content and membership services such as LINE Official Accounts, LINE promotional stamps, LINE flyers, LINE News, LINE Music, LYP Premium, and Yahoo! Email. The Commerce Business segment provides e-commerce services and platforms, including Yahoo! Shopping, ZOZOTOWN, ZOZOUSED, Lyst, ASKUL BtoB office-related product sales, LOHACO, Yahoo! Auctions, Yahoo! Flea Market, Ikyu.com, LINE Travel, and food delivery services in Thailand. The Strategic Business segment delivers payment and financial services, including PayPay (cashless payment), PayPay Card, PayPay Bank, PayPay Securities, LINE Pay, LINE Bank Taiwan, LINE Score, LINE FXJ, DOSI, LINE BITMAX, and other fintech offerings. The company was formerly known as Z Holdings Corporation and changed its name to LY Corporation in October 2023. LY Corporation was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. LY Corporation operates as a subsidiary of A Holdings Corporation.

EM Systems Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, sells, and maintains various IT systems for pharmacies, clinics, and care/welfare other business in Japan. The company operates through Dispensing Systems Business, Medical Systems Business, Nursing Care/Welfare System Business, and Other Business segments. It develops and sells IT systems for pharmacies, such as medical fee receipt computers and electronic medication record systems; IT systems for clinics, including medical accounting and electronic medical record systems; and office processing systems for care/welfare providers. In addition, the company offers staffing, pharmacy management, cashless, and development and operation of statistical information analysis services. EM Systems Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Osaka, Japan.

Weathernews Inc. engages in the provision of weather services in Japan, Asia, Europe, and America. It offers nautical marine, airline, helicopter and small aircraft weather, drone, road, railway, logistics, disaster prevention, event, construction, facility/factory, insurance, school, distribution, dam, agricultural, sports, mountaineering weather services as well as offshore energy meteorology, climate tech, energy and meteorology. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Chiba, Japan.

Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. provides system development and related services in Japan. It offers SONOBA COMET, a secure paperless meeting system that runs on tablets; Ofigo, a contract management and handling system that streamlines agreement and contract management operations; and LeGrad, a conversion tool that enables a system migration to support diverse program languages, databases, and platforms. The company also provides digital transformation, system development, maintenance, and operation, temporary staffing, IT consulting; and offshore development services. In addition, it offers system development solutions for public, communication, manufacturing, research and development, financial, and other industrial sectors. Computer Institute of Japan, Ltd. was incorporated in 1976 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.

Business Engineering Corporation designs, develops, and implements corporate information systems using ERP package products developed by other companies in Japan. It operates through Solution Business; Product Business; and System Support Business segments. The company provides IT planning consulting, system implementation consulting, system utilization consulting, project management service, system construction, template provision, offshore development, and overseas implementation support services. It also develops, sells, and introduces its packaged IT products, such as the mcframe series, GLASIAOUS, and Business b-ridge, as well as provides product development, product sales and marketing, professional, training operation and maintenance, and SaaS/ASP services; develop, sell, and provide implementation support for DX tools, targeting personnel working in manufacturing, logistics, construction, and healthcare fields; and operation and maintenance (AMS), design and development, IT outsourcing, and overseas local support services. The company was formerly known as Toyo Business Engineering Corporation. Business Engineering Corporation was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. plans, develops, and operates content for smartphone and other multi devices. It offers ATIS Traffic Info, a drive recorder function that records for traffic condition information; Women's Diary, a health care app for women; and Inaseri Ichiba website for general consumers that sells fisheries products, fruits, and vegetables. The company also provides business support services, such as kitting support, traffic information, and sound solution services; and application and system planning, development, and management services for enterprise customers to streamline their business operations, as well as advertising agent services. In addition, the company engages in the renewable power generation business. Nihon Enterprise Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

JFE Systems, Inc. engages in the planning, designing, developing, operating, and maintenance of information systems in Japan. The company also offers various business solutions, such as system integration, supply chain management systems, data science, AI, business system and low code development, ERP, BI, e-commerce, system coordination, digital form systems, cost management systems, procurement management systems, HR/payroll systems, and quality information management and manufacturing method management systems for the food products industry. In addition, it provides infrastructure solutions comprising cloud, server virtualization, network construction, virtualization technology, information security support, and voice cloud service; office solutions, manufacturing solutions, and platform construction support services; and systems development and maintenance for sales, production, logistics, accounting, costs, purchasing, supply and demand, quality, accounting, and pensions, etc. The company was formerly known as Kawasaki Steel Systems R&D Corporation and changed its name to JFE Systems, Inc. in 2004. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan. JFE Systems, Inc. is a subsidiary of JFE Steel Corporation.

Def consulting, inc. engages in the consulting business in Japan. It offers strategy consulting services for strategy and planning, business portfolio optimization, organizational strategy, marketing strategy, new business development, efficiency and process optimization, technology strategy, risk management and crisis response, international expansion strategy, evaluation and monitoring, strategic partnerships, and M and A support services. The company also provides technology consulting services, such as system integration, security assessment, data management and analytics, cloud service implementation support, software development and customization, optimizing IT infrastructure, and digital transformation strategy. In addition, it offers operation consulting services for business process improvement, restructuring and reorganization, improved operational efficiency and cost reduction, business and growth strategies, talent management and leadership development, and risk management and compliance services. Further, it engages in digital asset treasury business. The company was formerly known as Success Holders, Inc. and changed its name to Def consulting, inc. in August 2024. Def consulting, inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc., a music entertainment company, develops various content and solutions businesses in Japan. The company is involved in event, pay TV, platform, video production, alliance, entertainment cafe, distribution business. It also offers live music venues, artist management, labels agency, on-demand, digital marketing, fan clubs, e-commerce and merchandise. The company was formerly known as Space Shower Networks Inc. and changed its name to Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. in April 2024. Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Wowow Inc. provides broadcasting and related services in Japan. It procures and produces programs through broadcast satellite, as well as offers services through cable television, communication satellite, and IPTV. The company also provides telemarketing, and streaming services. The company was formerly known as Satellite Broadcasting, Inc. and changed its name to Wowow Inc. in December 2000. Wowow Inc. was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Tera Technology, Inc. operates as an information technology consulting company that offers information system design, operation, and maintenance services in Japan. The company offers services for business in five areas including public, communications, information services, finance, and manufacturing and others. The company's services for the public include electronic application system for local governments, billing acceptance system for care service providers, government integrated portal system, electronic approval system, support for big data operations in public institutions, and grant application system. It offers various system development projects for the telecommunications carrier industry, such as network infrastructure and content distribution. The company caters to information system industry by providing services, such as TV shopping EC site development, e-commerce website development for individuals/corporations, magazine production support system, department store point service system, delivery status management system for courier services, membership site for healthcare professionals, customer management system for cosmetics manufacturers, infrastructure construction for cloud service providers, migrating existing systems to the cloud, and core systems for internet service providers. Additionally, it offers software development services for finance, insurance, and securities companies. It also engages in the development of software for various manufacturing companies including automotive equipment, industrial machinery, medical device, in-house development, and service deployment. The company was formerly known as Terra International Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tera Technology, Inc. in February 2016. Tera Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Toshima, Japan.

Scala, Inc. engages DX business in Japan. It is also involved in human resources, EC business, incubation, and TCG business. The company was formerly known as Fusion Partners Co. and changed its name to Scala, Inc. in December 2016. Scala, Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Intelligent Wave Inc. provides system development services and system products in Japan and internationally. The company's technology is used primarily in online transaction processing systems for credit cards. It offers financial system solutions, including NET+1, a software product for handling online transactions over networks; ACEPlus system that detects fraudulent card payments in real time and minimizes the risk of fraudulent transactions; and EoM, an IP flow monitoring solution for broadcasting industry. The company also provides security products, such as CWAT, a multidimensional information security software platform combating information leaks and preventing critical data extrusion by centrally monitoring and controlling network and terminal operations within a company. In addition, it sells hardware products. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Intelligent Wave Inc. is a subsidiary of Dai Nippon Printing Co., Ltd.

PowerX,Inc. manufactures and sells energy storage systems. It provides stationary energy storage systems, including PowerX Mega Power; PowerX cube for grid-mounted batteries, renewable energy-integrated batteries, and industrial and commercial batteries; and PowerX Hypercharger for commercial EV charging/public charging infrastructure applications, as well as battery tankers for maritime business. The company also offers electricity supply and aggregation services, as well as electric vehicle charging services. In additionit provides its services through PowerX app. PowerX,Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Tamano, Japan.

MediciNova, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on developing novel and small molecule therapeutics for the treatment of serious diseases with unmet medical needs in the United States. It develops MN-166 (ibudilast), an oral anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective agent in Phase 2 clinical trial for treating neurological and other disorders, such as progressive multiple sclerosis, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, degenerative cervical myelopathy, and glioblastoma, as well as prevention of acute respiratory distress syndrome. The company is also developing MN-001 (tipelukast), an orally bioavailable small molecule compound in Phase 2 clinical trial to treat fibrotic and other metabolic disorders, including nonalcoholic fatty liver disease and hypertriglycedemia. MediciNova, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in La Jolla, California.

CellSource Co., Ltd. engages in the regenerative medicine-related businesses in Japan. The company provides processing services to extract adipose-derived stem cells from patients' adipose tissues, and to prepare platelet-rich plasma from patients' blood; and offers support services for medical facilities providing regenerative medicine therapy. It is also involved in the sale of human stem cell-derived cosmetic ingredients; and Signalift series of anti-aging products, including a serum. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

FunPep Company Limited engages in the research and development of pharmaceuticals drugs, functional cosmetics, and medical devices in Japan and internationally. The company develops SR-0379, a functional peptide which is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of skin ulcer; FPP003, an antibody-inducing peptide which is in Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of psoriasis and ankylosing spondylitis; FPP004X, an antibody-inducing peptide which is in Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of pollinosis; and FPP005, an antibody-inducing peptide which is in pre-clinical trial stage for the treatment of psoriasis. It is also involved in the development of Curepeptin, an antimicrobial peptide that disrupts bacterial cell membranes. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Ibaraki, Japan.

Perseus Proteomics Inc., a drug discovery biotech venture company, develops and sells antibody-based pharmaceuticals and research reagents for cancer and other diseases in Japan. The company is involved in the antibody discovery activities; and antibody research support activities comprising hybridoma antibody sequencing, antibody protein production, and contract antibody research activities, as well as supply of antibody products. Its product pipeline includes PPMX-T001, an anti-hepatocarcinoma antibody; PPMX-T002, an anticancer drug; PPMX-T003, a drug for the treatment of adult T-cell; and PPMX-T004, an antibody drug conjugate. Perseus Proteomics Inc. has a joint research agreement with ASKA Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. for the development of new antibody drugs and therapeutic drugs for specific disease areas. Perseus Proteomics Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Modalis Therapeutics Corporation engages in the research and development of therapeutics to treat patients with serious genetic disorders. The company is developing therapies for genetic diseases using its proprietary CRISPR-GNDM an epigenome editing technology that combines dCas9. It also develops various therapeutics for muscle disorders, cardiomyopathy, and CNS disorders. The company was formerly known as EdiGENE Corporation and changed its name to Modalis Therapeutics Corporation in August 2019. Modalis Therapeutics Corporation was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Kringle Pharma, Inc. engages in research and develops therapeutic agents for the treatment of intractable diseases in Japan. The company develops HGF products for the treatment of acute spinal cord injury, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, vocal fold scar, and acute kidney injury. Kringle Pharma, Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Kita, Japan.

Muromachi Chemicals Inc. plans, produces, and distributes pharmaceuticals, health foods, and chemicals in Japan. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients and intermediate synthesis products; commissioned processing services for pharmaceuticals; and commissioned synthesis services, including GLP analysis, storage, stability testing, and repurification of radioisotopes. The company also provides traditional tablets; jelly; and non-alcoholic beverage products. In addition, it offers ion-exchange resins; separation membranes; water-treatment products; and contract processing services. Further, it provides functional adhesives; product contamination removal and dust removal mats, and antistatic products for use in the electronics industry; and engages in the commissioned manufacturing and processing of functional pastes. The company was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Omuta, Japan.

Sawai Group Holdings Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of pharmaceuticals. The company offers generic drugs in various dosage forms for therapeutic areas comprising cardiovascular and antibiotic preparations, central nervous system drugs, other metabolic drugs, digestive tract medicines, blood and body fluid medications, allergy medications, respiratory medicine, vitamin supplements, oncology drugs, chemotherapeutic agents, genitourinary and anal drugs, and others. It sells its generic drugs through distributors, wholesalers, and retailers. Sawai Group Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Stella Pharma Corporation engages in research and development, manufacturing, and distribution of pharmaceuticals. The company develops drugs for boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT). Its products include SPM-011, a boron-containing drug for BNCT used for treating head and neck cancer, recurrent malignant glioma, meningioma, malignant melanoma and angiosarcoma, glioblastoma, and thoracic malignant tumor. Stella Pharma Corporation was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Renascience Inc. develops and sells pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and artificial intelligence (AI)-powered programmed medical devices in Japan. The company is developing RS5614, a PAI-1 inhibitor product candidate for use in the treatment of chronic myeloid leukemia, malignant melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, cutaneous angio-sarcoma, coronavirus lung injury, and interstitial lung disease associated with systemic scleroderma; RS5441, PAI-1 inhibitor for the treatment of alopecia disease that is in Phase I clinical trials; and RS8001, a water-soluble vitamin for use in the treatment of premenstrual syndrome/premenstrual dysphoric mood disorder and menopausal disorder, which is in phase 1 clinical trials. It is also developing RS9001, a disposable ultrafine endoscope; artificial intelligence-based medical solutions; pancreatic cancer; anti-aging and longevity oral drugs (senolytics); topical medications for male pattern baldness and age-related hair loss; and diagnostic solutions. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Sendai, Japan.

Tsubota Laboratory Incorporated engages in the development and sale of pharmaceuticals and medical devices for the treatment of myopia, dry eyes, presbyopia, and brain diseases in Japan, China, France, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

TMS Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of drug products, quasi-drugs, drug substances, medical devices, and medical commodities. The company is developing TMS-007, a stachybotrys microspora triprenyl phenol (SMTP) congener with prothrombolytic and anti-inflammatory/antioxidative activities, which has completed Phase 2a clinical trials for acute ischemic stroke treatment; and TMS-008, an SMTP congener with anti-inflammatory/antioxidative activities under nonclinical development for inflammatory complications, such as acute kidney injury and cancer cachexia. It is also developing TMS-009, a product candidate in preclinical development. In addition, the company has a collaboration with Hokkaido University to evaluate the potential of the drug candidate compounds as novel drugs. TMS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Fuchu, Japan.

Cyfuse Biomedical K.K. develops, manufactures, and sells regenerative medicine-related products in Japan, Europe, and the United States. The company offers the Bio 3D Printer for use in the regeneration of various tissues and organs, such as cartilage and bone, blood vessels, and nerves; regenova, a 3D software that creates 3D data where spheroids shall be mounted; and S-PIKE that develops 3D-structures from cells. It also provides the Human 3D Mini-Liver, an in vitro MASH model that recapitulates human liver functions and predicts efficacy of drugs. Cyfuse Biomedical K.K. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Noile-Immune Biotech Inc. researches and develops CAR-T cells for novel cancer immunotherapies. The company's product pipeline includes, NIB101, a target antigen for solid tumors; NIB102, a next-generation CAR-T cell therapy; NIB103, autologous CAR-T cell therapy for mesothelin (MSLN); NIB104, a PRIME technology against target antigens in solid tumors; ADAP01; AUTL01; and CHUG01. Noile-Immune Biotech Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Cuorips Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, commercialization, and sale of human iPS cell-derived cardiomyocyte sheets in Japan. The company offers cellular and tissue-based, and cell processing products. It also provides contract development and manufacturing, and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Cuore Inc. and changed its name to Cuorips Inc. in June 2017. Cuorips Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

K Pharma,Inc. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of regenerative medicines and pharmaceutical products in Japan. It develops regenerative medicine products using disease-specific induced pluripotent stem (iPS) cell technology for spinal cord injuries and cerebral infarctions. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation provides products and services in the fields of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and internationally. Its Healthcare segment offers products and services, such as medical devices, biomedical contract development and manufacturing organization, pharmaceutical, regenerative medicine, and cosmetics and supplements in the areas of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment; equipment and materials for medical systems; drug discovery support, such as iPS cells; and cell culture media and reagents. The Electronic segment provides display and touch panels, semiconductors and image sensors, and functional film materials; storage media and archiving services; semiconductor and display materials; industrial equipment; and fine chemicals. Its Business Innovation segment offers office equipment, including multi-function devices and printers; problem-solving document services tailored to diverse business formats and roles, including system integration, cloud service, business process outsourcing, and others; equipment and materials for graphic communications; and inks and industrial inkjet printheads. Its Imaging segment provides color films, instant cameras, developing and printing systems, color papers, and photo printing services; TV and cinema lenses, surveillance cameras, industrial lenses for production line inspection, and projectors; instant photo systems; services for photofinishing; digital cameras; and optical devices. FUJIFILM Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Konica Minolta, Inc. engages in digital workplace, professional print, imaging solutions, and industry business in Japan, China, Asia, the United States, European countries, and internationally. It develops, manufactures, and sells multi-functional peripherals and related consumables; and digital printing systems and related consumables for industrial and commercial printing market, as well as provides printing and IT services and solutions. The company also provides diagnostic imaging systems and related services; and digitalization, networking, diagnostic services, and solutions in medical field. In addition, it offers measuring instruments, as well as related solutions and services; lenses for industrial and professional use, and others; and industrial inkjet printheads and others. Further, it offers visual-related equipment; functional films for displays and other; and network cameras. Additionally, the company engages in the development, manufacture, provision, and sale of services of solutions utilizing the common fundamental technology; and development, sale, and consultation of products, information systems, and services related to nursing care services. Konica Minolta, Inc. was founded in 1873 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Shiseido Company, Limited produces and sells in Japan and internationally. It offers fragrances, skincare, and makeup products through retail channels. The company also engages in the restaurant and food businesses; and operates beauty salons. In addition, it operates and supports SABFA, a professional hair makeup training school. Further, the company manages childcare facilities. It serves its products under the BAUM, BENEFIQUE, Clé de Peau Beauté, Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare, Drunk Elephant, EFFECTIM, Gallinée, INOUI, IPSA, ISSEY MIYAKE PARFUMS, NARS, narciso rodriguez, Serge Lutens, SHISEIDO, THE GINZA, Tory Burch Beauty, ZADIG&VOLTAIRE, ANESSA, AQUA LABEL, AUPRES, d program, ELIXIR, HAKU, INTEGRATE, MAJOLICA MAJORCA, MAQuillAGE, PRIOR, REVITAL, URARA, INRYU, The Collagen, and Perfect Cover brands. The company sells its products through department, specialized cosmetic, drug, and general merchandise stores. Shiseido Company, Limited was founded in 1872 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Shikizai, Inc. researches and develops, manufactures, and sells cosmetics in Japan and France. The company offers base makeup products, such as cream, stick, liquid, compact, and cushion foundation, as well as concealer; cream base and liquid primer; loose and pressed powder; chip on powder eyebrow, eyebrow cream, and eyebrow mascara; mascara remover, eyelash serum, glitter mascara, and mascara; and liquid, glitter, and pencil eyeliner. It also provides stick, liquid, cream, powder blush, and highlighter; liquid, pencil, powder, and cream eyeshadow; and lipstick, lipstick marble, and lip gloss. In addition, the company offers skincare/UV products comprising toner, makeup remover, cream, and moisturizer; UV cream/gel, milk, powder, and stick; and design filler, quasi-drug item, and other products. The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

KOSE Holdings Corporation manufactures and sells cosmetics in Japan and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Cosmetics Business and Cosmetology Business. It offers cosmetics under the Sekkisei, Esprique, and One By Kosé brands through cosmetics stores, mass merchandisers, and drugstores; and cosmetics and toiletries, such as shampoos and conditioners through mass retailers, drugstores, department stores, convenience stores, and other retail outlets, as well as skin diagnosis services. The company was formerly known as KOSÉ Corporation and changed its name to KOSE Holdings Corporation in January 2026. KOSE Holdings Corporation was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

HABA Laboratories,Inc. manufactures and sells skin care, and hair and body care products in Japan and internationally. The company's skin care products include cleansers/face washes, toners, special care products, and squalane oils; and hair and body care products, such as shampoos, conditioners, hair treatment, body shampoo, hand care, and hand and body soaps products. It also offers petroleum-based surfactants, synthetic fragrances, mineral oil, and tar-based dyes. It sells its products through online shopping, shop sales, and drug/variety stores. The company has shops located in department stores, shopping malls, etc. HABA Laboratories,Inc. was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Pola Orbis Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells cosmetics and related products in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through Beauty Care, Real Estate, and Others segments. The company offers beauty and health products under the POLA, ORBIS, Jurlique, THREE, DECENCIA, and FUJIMI brand names. It is also involved in the leasing of office buildings in urban areas, as well as management and operation of buildings. Pola Orbis Holdings Inc. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. engages in developing and selling cosmetics and healthcare products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Mail Order, Wholesale Sales, and Overseas Sales segments. It offers health food, such as supplements and green juice, as well as healthcare products that include medicine. The company also provides skincare products under the Perfect One, Perfect One Focus brands, Fun&Health, and TONOU brands; and pharmaceutical products for various diseases and symptoms. In addition, it operates a network of stores and online shops. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Shinnihonliving Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. in April 2002. Shinnihonseiyaku Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Almado, Inc. engages in the planning, development, and sale of cosmetics and supplements in Japan. The company offers skin care products, including serum; serum for whitening; moisturizing eggshell membrane; wrinkle-reducing, moisturizing, firmness, and glow; facial cleansing and makeup removal with electrolyzed water; brightening lotion and cream; and hyaluronic acid spicules products. It offers beauty, beauty drink, and hair growth supplement products. In addition, it is involved in the contract manufacturing activities. The company markets its products under the Ode and CELLULA brands. It sells its products to TV shopping channels, OME manufacturing companies, drug stores, hairdressers, and mail order companies, as well as operates an e-commerce website. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Premier Anti-Aging Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, import, export, mail order/EC, wholesale, and retail of cosmetics, health foods, and recovery wear in Japan. The company is involved in anti-aging and recovery businesses; and manufactures and sells skin care, hair care, and inner care products. It offers its products under the DUO, CANADEL, Clayence, C+mania, Sinto, Sitrana, Reinca, and Lalaskin brands. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Liberta Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the planning and sale of beauty products, household and daily miscellaneous goods, and functional clothing products in Japan and internationally. The company offers health and beauty products, including foot care items, deodorant cream, toothpaste, adult scents, and makeup under the Baby Foot, Quick Beauty, DENTISTE, Slowbliss, Dext, and COSCOS brands; functional apparel under the FREEZE TECH, heatmaster, DEODRIZETECH, and ThermOne brands; household detergents, mold remover, and washing machine drum removers under the KABIDASH, Kabi Tornado, SHWATCH, and Mama La Clean brands; foods and general goods under ThinOptics and ATHMEAL brands; and watches under Luminox and Libenham brands. It is also involved in PR marketing and other businesses; mail order businesses; beauty salons, and other businesses, as well as water purifiers and medical equipment from Waterworks, military watches, Oral Doctor, and LaLuna. The company sells its products through department stores, mass retailers, drug stores, as well as ecommerce. Liberta Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

AXXZIA Inc. manufactures and sells cosmetics and supplements in Japan. The company offers eyecare, skincare, supplements and drinks, salon care, hair care, hair styling, and beauty device products under the AXXZIA, AGtheory, LisBeau, LisBlanc, The B, Le Ciel de L'aube, Aither, NICE GLOW, Medullux, Venus Recipe, and RevWell brand names. It also provides products online. AXXZIA Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Waqoo Inc. engages in the planning, development, and sale of original brand cosmetics in Japan. It offers skin care products, such as cleansing, facial cleanser, hot cleansing, whitening serum, whitening face wash, and whitening cleansing products; proteins; makeup base; and hair care products, including hair oil and mask, and head spa hair growth agent products under the HADANATURE brand through its own e-commerce site. Additionally, it provides contract processing services for blood-derived products in the regenerative medicine field. It also sells cosmetics and raw materials and is expanding its business to develop new products and strengthen existing brands through marketing activities. The company serves consumers, patients, and medical institutions, primarily in Japan. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. Waqoo Inc. operates as a subsidiary of SBC Medical Group Co., Ltd.

Konishi Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells synthetic adhesives in Japan. It operates through three segments: Bonds, Chemical Products, and Construction Business. The company offers general household adhesives, repair material, and tape for consumer sector; interior construction adhesive, general residential sealant, and construction tape for housing-related fields; industrial adhesives, industrial tape, and industrial release agent, as well as various resin products for industrial materials; building construction repair sealant; and adhesives and repair materials for civil engineering construction. It also trades in chemical products for automotive, electronics and electrical, chemicals, paint, and housing related fields. In addition, the company engages in the provision of investigation, design, cost estimation, and construction of repair, reinforcement, and renovation work for concrete structures; contracting civil engineering and construction projects using construction adhesives; construction work for bridges and expressways. Further, it is involved in planning, design, construction and supervision of civil engineering and building works; and design and construction of architectural and civil engineering works. Konishi Co., Ltd. was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of surface treatment chemicals and machinery in Japan, Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through Surface Finishing Materials Business, Surface Finishing Machinery Business, Plating Job Business, Real Estate Rental Business, and Other segments. The company offers plating chemicals and machines for printed wiring boards and aluminum magnetic disks, industrial chemicals, and non-ferrous metals. It also provides electronic circuit boards, including package boards, rigid and flexible printed wiring boards, plating equipment, and plating solution control systems; semiconductors, such as logic and memory devices; electric components comprising connectors, passive devices, and power devices; and functional plating, which includes pre-treatment, composite and nickel plating, and plating solution control systems. In addition, the company offers copper plating, final finish, electroless plating, and hard disk media Ni-P plating processes, as well as electrolytic plating process for bump formation; chemical pre and post treatment, and stripper, as well as chromium, zinc, tin and tin alloy, gold, silver, and palladium plating; polishing compounds solutions, such as solid and liquid buffing, and barrell, as well as polishing equipment; and surface finishing systems. Further, it is involved in the leasing of office buildings, apartment houses, and factory land. C.Uyemura & Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1848 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells OTC pharmaceuticals, guasi-drugs, deodorizing air fresheners, and sanitary products in Japan, the United States, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers Ammeltz, an anti-inflammatory pain relief medicine; Dent, an effervescent denture cleaning agent; Ekitai Bluelet Okudake, a toilet bowl cleaner; Naicitol, a Chinese herbal medicine that promotes the breakdown and metabolism of fat; BreathCare, an oral breath freshener capsule; Netsusama sheet, a cooling gel sheet; and deodorizing air fresheners, lens cleaners, and oral hygiene products. It also manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, fragrances, deodorants, cosmetics, health food, synthetic resin processed products, paper products, and hand warmers; and sells daily necessities. In addition, the company engages in transportation, real estate management, advertising planning and production, sales promotion and market research, promotional goods production and sales, and asset management activities, as well as in pharmacy, retail, and cleaning industries. Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1886 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Arakawa Chemical Industries, Ltd. provides chemicals for functional coating agents and paper manufacturing, resins for printing inks and adhesives, and materials for electronics in Japan, China, Asia, North and South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Functional Coating Chemicals, Paper Chemicals & Environmental Business, Adhesive & Biomass Materials, Fine Chemicals & Electronics, and Other segments. It offers functional coating chemicals comprising photo-curable, thermosetting, rosin modified phenolic, polyurethane, maleic, alkyd, polyester, modified epoxy, and styrene maleic resins, as well as resins for printing ink and paint, and functional coating agents; and paper chemicals and environmental products consisting of internal and wet paper strengthening agents, sizing agents, new water-based polymers, internal and surface size, sprayable paper strengthening agents, paper surface improving agents, and water repellant agents. It also provides adhesive and biomass materials, such as hydrogenated hydrocarbon resins, tackifiers for adhesive and pressure sensitive adhesive, colorless rosin derivatives, emulsifiers for synthetic rubber polymerization, rosin esters, terpene and alkyl phenolic resins, disproportionate and polymerized rosins, and hydrogenated rosins; and fine chemicals and electronic products, including precise parts cleaning agents, cleaning systems and its peripheral equipment, low-dielectric polyimide resins, compounds for electronic materials, precision polishing agents, solders for use in electronics, thermoplastic polyimide solutions, organic-inorganic hybrid resins, and hybrid polyimide films. In addition, the company offers non-life insurance and real estate management activities.  The company was formerly known as Arakawa Forest Chemical Industries, Ltd. and changed its name to Arakawa Chemical Industries, Ltd. in April 1977. The company was founded in 1876 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells photosensitive materials and polymer products in Japan, China, Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers negative photosensitive materials for use as a cross-linking agent for photo-curing resins; positive photosensitive materials for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits and liquid crystal displays; chemically amplified photoacid generator for microfabrication of semiconductor integrated circuits; and acrylic polymer for resist. It also provides chemicals products, such as alcohols, aldehydes, acids, ketones, esters, ethers, hydrocarbons, and nitrogen compounds. In addition, the company offers logistic services, including ship receiving systems; shipping systems; chemical transport services; and storage equipment comprising fully automated dangerous goods 3d automatic warehouse, drum filling station, dangerous goods refilling equipment, blending equipment, temperature control system, analysis room, Ichikawa distillation equipment, and deodorization tower. The company was formerly known as Nihon Acetylene Chemical Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. in May 1961. Toyo Gosei Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1954 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

MEC Company Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of chemicals, equipment, and related materials for the production of printed circuit boards in Japan, Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, Thailand, and Europe. It offers various chemicals for electronic substrates, such as roughening type adhesion enhancement; rolled annealed copper roughening treatment; pre-lamination treatment of multilayer substrates and adhesion enhancement for high-frequency substrates; anisotropic etching and seed layer etching; copper surface treatment for CO2 laser direct drilling; degreasing, rust removal, and temporary anti-tarnish; other metal surface treatment; DFR pre-treatment; microetching; etch down; and various residue removal treatments. The company also provides AMALPHA, a metal surface treatment technology for direct metal and resin bonding. MEC Company Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precious metal plating chemicals for electronic components in Japan and internationally. The company provides gold electrolytic plating formulation for semiconductor applications, as well as PWB, connector, contact, and soldering applications; flash gold plating formulation for lead frame uses; and palladium electrolytic formulation for connector and lead frame uses. It also offers gold plating formulation for soldering and wire bonding; electroless palladium plating formulation for wire bonding and soldering uses; and electrolytic and electroless silver plating formulations. In addition, the company provides anti-bacterial agents for plating tanks and drag-out tanks; and impurity removal resin that removes Cu ions dissolved in Au and palladium plating formulation. Additionally, it offers surface treatment chemicals and stripping agents. Japan Pure Chemical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

JCU Corporation engages in the produces and sells chemicals, machines, and auxiliary equipment in Japan. It operates through Chemicals and Equipment business segments. The company offers surface treatment chemicals for the decoration and rustproofing of automobile parts, faucet parts, construction materials, etc.; and for use in the manufacturing processes of printed circuit boards (PCBs), electronic components and semiconductors, etc. used in electronic equipment. It provides full automatic plating and processing machines; etching and washing devices for PCBs; and surface treatment equipment, as well as offers electricity from solar power generation equipment. The company was formerly known as Ebara-Udylite Co., Ltd. and changed its name to JCU Corporation in October 2012. JCU Corporation was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toyo Drilube Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, coating processing, and sale of solid film lubricants and functional film coating agents in Japan and internationally. Its solid film lubricants are formulated with solid lubricants, such as molybdenum disulfide, fluorine resin, or graphite; and dispersed in binders. The company also exports lube products. It serves industries related to automobiles, electric home appliances and electronics, and optical instruments. Toyo Drilube Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nitta Gelatin Inc. engages in the production and sale of gelatin, collagen peptide, collagen, and food materials in Japan. The company manufactures and sells related products made from collagen for animal bones and skin, and fish scales and skin; gelatin for applications in industrial sectors comprising food and pharmaceutical markets; and collagen peptide, which is proven as a physiological activity and that has bioregulatory functions, produced using its proteolytic technology. It also offers edible gelling agent and stabilizers for used in confectionery, desserts, delicatessen items, chilled food products, etc. In addition, the company provides collagen and medical gelatin for medical device manufacturers, research institutions, and others that are used as a biomaterial for artificial skin and bone. Nitta Gelatin Inc. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

ReproCELL Incorporated provides stem cell research and drug discovery services in Japan. It offers stem cell reagents, including RNA reprogramming, small molecules, growth factors and cytokines, antibodies and staining kits, cell substrates, cryopreservation media, dissociation solution, and transfection reagents; differentiated induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) and related reagents, feeder cells, pluripotent stem cells, StemEdit gene edited iPSCs, mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), and new immortalized cell lines and related reagents; and iPSC-derived exosomes. The company also provides Alvetex 3D, a cell culture system; Alvetex, an advanced tissue bioengineering system; EZSPHERE Multiwell Dishes and Plates; KOKEN atelocollagen; ABLE Biott bioreactor systems; and 2mag stirrer systems. In addition, It offers research stem cell, genomics, clinical stem cell research, preclinical and drug discovery, precision medicine, human tissue samples, clinical laboratory, and gene editing services. ReproCELL Incorporated was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Yokohama, Japan.

OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells agrochemicals and fertilizers in Japan and internationally. The company provides Cyflumetofen, a plant protection product; Kaligreen, a fungicide to control a range of fungal diseases in fruits, vegetables and flowers; and Flutianil, plant protection product against the fungal pathogens. It also offers Samppi/Kemppi fertilizer, which contains a biostim power composition; Atonik, a plant growth regulator and biostimulant; Potatol a product with components that promotes photosynthesis and maintains plant growth in various plant cultivation; and Misaki, which is designed for cut flowers. OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Otsuka Chemical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to OAT Agrio Co., Ltd. in 2014. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Dexerials Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components, bonding materials, optics materials and semiconductor, and other products in Japan. It operates through two segments: Optical Materials and Component and Electronic Materials and Components.
