The company offers anisotropic conductive films, anti-reflection film, optical elastic resins, industrial adhesive tapes, secondary protection fuse, opto semiconductor elements, optical and opto sensors and optical communication-use devices, inorganic waveplates and polarizers, sputtering targets, eye shield material for medical, double and single coated tapes, inorganic optical components, UV curable resins for optical disks, sputtering targets, as well as anti-fog and stain-resistant solution, and leak repair products through Infra-Aid brand, as well as optical semiconductors. Its products are used in various applications, such as television, note and tablet PC, smartphones, automobiles, optical communication, factory automation, currency validation, medical and healthcare, and analyzers and measuring equipment. The company was formerly known as Sony Chemical & Information Device Corporation and changed its name to Dexerials Corporation in September 2012. Dexerials Corporation was founded in 1962 and is headquartered in Tochigi, Japan.

Hokko Chemical Industry Co., Ltd., together with subsidiaries, manufactures and sells crop protection and fine chemicals products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Agricultural Chemicals Business, Fine Chemicals Business, and Textile Materials Business. It offers insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulators, pesticides, and related products; resin additives, pharmaceutical and agrochemical intermediates, raw materials for electronics components, functional polymers, organic catalysts, raw materials for functional inorganic materials, fine ceramics, raw materials for agricultural chemicals and artificial intelligence in the electronic materials field, preservatives, antifouling, antiseptic and antifungal agents, epoxy resin curing accelerators and related products; and textile materials. The company also provides raw resin materials, such as photoresist monomers and curing accelerators for epoxy molding compounds, semiconductor encapsulants; and electronic materials. Hokko Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

long_name: Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd.
business_summary: Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. develops and sells liquid and paste packaging systems in Japan. The company offers films, including XA-series, rev spec series, environmental series, film technology, and other products; and filling machines, such as DANGAN series products and filling peripheral equipment, as well as IoT cloud and product maintenance services. It also provides a filling training program. The company was formerly known as Taisei Lamick Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. in April 2025. Taisei Lamick Group Head Quarter & Innovation Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Shiraoka, Japan.

Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agricultural chemicals in Japan, Asia, North America, Central America, South America, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Pesticides, Chemicals Other Than Pesticides, and Others. It offers crop protection products, including fungicides, insecticides, and herbicides; crop aid and adjuvant products, such as biostimulants, adjuvants, and soil conditioners; termiticides and other chemical products; pharmaceuticals comprising topical antifungal drugs; flea/tick control agents for animals; wood preservatives; and agricultural materials. The company also engages in landscaping and greening construction; real estate rental; logistics services; and pesticide residue analysis. It exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1926 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan. Nihon Nohyaku Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Adeka Corporation.

Nichireki Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of applied and processed asphalt products in Japan. The company offers applied and processed asphalt products, including asphalt emulsions, modified asphalt, bridge deck waterproofing materials, road surface repairing materials, crack repairing materials, landscape paving materials, and industrial products, as well as involved in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of construction and civil engineering materials. It also provides contracting services for road paving; bridge deck waterproofing; water and sewage; and other civil engineering works, such as relevant survey and diagnosis, design, and administration process solutions. In addition, the company offers surveys and consulting services, such as road surface properties and conditions survey, nondestructive pavement structure diagnosis, and bridge deck survey system. The company was formerly known as Nichireki Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nichireki Group Co., Ltd. in October 2024. Nichireki Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Yushiro Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells metalworking oils and fluids, and building maintenance products in Japan, the Americas, the United States, China, Southeast Asia, and India. The company offers cutting and grinding oils and fluids, including water miscible cutting and grinding fluids, and straight cutting and grinding oils; forming oils and fluids comprising water miscible cold rolling oils, straight rolling oils, hot rolling oils for seamless pipes, and non-graphite hot forging oils, as well as drawing, pressing oils and cold forging oils; and surface treatment agents, such as rust preventives, metal cleaners, car paint protective coatings, and car body protective waxes. It also provides water miscible cutting fluids for inner diamond blade saws; straight slurry bases for multi blade and multi wire saws, fire resistant water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw, and water miscible slurry bases for multi wire saw; grinding fluids for aluminum and glass disks, and diamond slurries for magnetic heads; aluminum and magnesium diecast lubricants, urethane foam mold release agents, and plunger tip lubricants; aquaous quenchant products; fire resistant hydraulic fluids; and deodoran products. In addition, the company offers building maintenance products, including floor polishing chemicals, such as urethane and acrylic resin waxes, and water and oil-based floor waxes; floor cleaners comprising surface cleaners, stripping agents, and carpet cleaners; hand soaps; and floor maintenance equipment, including maintenance riding carts. Further, provides 
machinery and equipment, and transportation equipment. The company was formerly known as Yushiro Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yushiro Inc. in April 2025. Yushiro Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

BP Castrol K.K., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells automotive lubricants in Japan. It provides gasoline and diesel engine oil, automotive gear oil, and car care products, as well as ATF products, including CVT fluid under the Castrol and BP brands. The company also buys, sells, imports, and exports crude oil, LNG, and petroleum products; research, develops, manufactures, buys, sells, imports, and exports lubricating oils, greases, coolants, brake fluids, cleaning agents, rust inhibitors, antifreeze and related products. It sells its products to car shops, home improvement centers, tire shops, auto repair shops, and car dealers. The company was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan. BP Castrol K.K. is a subsidiary of Castrol Limited.

JX Advanced Metals Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells materials made from copper and rare metals in Japan. The company operates through Semiconductor Materials, ICT Materials, and Metals & Recycling segments. It offers copper alloys/foil, sputtering targets, compound semiconductors and crystal materials, metal and compound powders, special ceramic powders, high-purity metals, surface treatment agents, upinorg (high-purity copper sulfate), electroless UBM plating service, heater, shielding materials, stainless steel, and nonferrous metals and chemical products. The company also provides titanium sponge, THC catalysts, electrolytic copper, cast copper, precious metals, sulfuric acid, and EMI shielding films. The company was formerly known as JX Metals Corporation and changed its name to JX Advanced Metals Corporation in May 2024. JX Advanced Metals Corporation was founded in 1905 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

MORESCO Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells chemical products in Japan, China, Southeast/South Asia, and North America. The company offers die casting lubricants, including water-soluble minimum quantity spray type lubricant, water-soluble diluted type, powder release agent, as well as for zinc, magnesium, and squeeze and low speed processes; water soluble cutting fluids; and hot melt adhesives. It also provides radiation resistant lubricating oil and greases; and sodium, calcium, barium, synthetic sulfonates, as well as packaged rust-preventative, packaged emulsified oil, and packaged soluble oil additive; gas and water vapor transmittance measurement device; plunger lubricants; high vacuum pump oil; synthetic lubricating oils; and hard disk surface lubricant. In addition, the company offers heat transfer medium; flexible organic photovoltaics; lubricant for hot forging; fire-resistant hydraulic fluid and other products; high temperature lubricating oils and greases, such as L/LM/RX series, LE series, MO series, LS-E/R series, BS series, and High temperature greases; liquid paraffin, purified liquid paraffin, and lubricants and grease for food machinery; organic device sealant; and wastewater treatment agents and equipment comprising emulsion breaker wastewater treatment agents, coagulant treatment equipment, and UF membrane wastewater treatment equipment. Its products are used in automobiles, iron and steel, construction materials, fibers, food, packaging materials, nuclear power related, plastic, sanitary and daily goods, cosmetics/pharmaceuticals, factory and equipment related, electronic equipment and home electric appliances, aircraft, industrial machinery, wastewater treatment, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Matsumura Oil Reserch Corp. and changed its name to MORESCO Corporation in 2009. MORESCO Corporation was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Idemitsu Kosan Co.,Ltd. engages in the fuel oil, basic chemicals, functional materials, power and renewable energy, and resources businesses in Japan, Singapore, Asia, Oceania, North America, and internationally. The Fuel Oil segment engages in the production, sale, import, export, and trading in petroleum refined products comprising sustainable aviation fuel, synthetic fuel, biofuels, and carbon offset fuel; and operation of service stations that provide refueling, car wash, vehicle inspection, and maintenance services. Its Basic Chemicals segment produces and sells olefin and aromatic products, which include ethylene, propylene, linealene/alpha olefin, paraxylene, cyclohexane, and styrene monomer. The Functional Materials segment offers lubricants, functional chemicals, electronic materials, and bitumen/functional paving materials, as well as agri-bio products, pesticides and functional feed products. Its Renewable Energy segment engages in power generation from thermal, solar, and wind power; sale of electricity; and solar business. The Resources segment is involved in the exploration, development, production, and sale of crude oil, natural gas, and coal; and geothermal power generation. It is also involved in insurance businesses. Idemitsu Kosan Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

ENEOS Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates in the energy petroleum and natural gas development, functional material, electricity and city gas, and renewable energy businesses in Japan, Singapore, China, and internationally. The company engages in petroleum product refining and sales; petrochemical product manufacturing and sales; and development, manufacturing, and sales of lubricant products. It also develops and produces oil and natural gas; and research, develops, manufactures, and sells synthetic rubbers, thermoplastic elastomers, latex, and other raw materials. In addition, the company is involved in power generation, storage batteries, and city gas business; and renewable energy business, such as solar, wind, and biomass power generation, as well as development and operation of power plants. ENEOS Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the petroleum business in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Petroleum, Petrochemical, Oil Exploration and Production, and Renewable Energy. The Petroleum segment produces and sells gasoline, naphtha, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, crude oil, lubricating oil, liquefied petroleum gas, and asphalt. The Petrochemical segment produces and sells ethylene, mixed xylene, and petrochemical solvents. The Oil Exploration and Production segment develops, produces, and sells crude oil. The Renewable Energy segment supplies and sells electricity generated by wind power. It is also involved in planning in the energy exploration and production business; imports and exports, refining, storage, and sales of crude oil and petroleum products, etc.; sells oil products; vehicle leasing and low-carbon solutions; marine transportation and shipping agency business. In addition, the company engages in the provision of oil storage, receiving, shipping works; manufacture, storage, transport, sale, import, and export of LP gas; oil receiving and shipping; waste incineration management, experiment, inspection, guard and security; distribution terminal, port, operation of service stations; electricity retailing; accounting, finance, purchasing, general affairs, and human resources related business outsourcing services; wind power generation business; engineering, construction and maintenance for industrial facilities; and general trading. Cosmo Energy Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

MERCURY Inc. engages in the real estate information platform business in Japan. The company operates through platform business, and digital marketing business. The company provides Summary Series, a subscription-based real estate market research and analysis system; RearNavi, a SaaS-type real estate information platform; Apartment data download service, a platform for sales and support service for real estate brokers; data provision, a platform which provides property details, market price information, and other data. It also offers CGM advertising, listing advertising operations, web advertising operations, site production, system development outsourcing, website creation, and advertising planning and sales. The company was formerly known as MERCURY REALTECH INNOVATOR Inc. and changed its name to MERCURY Inc. in September 2024. MERCURY Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Minato, Japan. MERCURY Inc. is a subsidiary of GA technologies Co., Ltd.

Tripleize Co.,Ltd. engages in the provision of system integration and AI platform services in Japan. It offers AIZE, eyes' proprietary image recognition platform; DX solutions through AI engineering; and web development, infrastructure network construction, core/information system construction, and cloud infrastructure services. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

AnyMind Group Inc., a technology company, provides a platform for brand building, production management, media operations, e-commerce site development and management, marketing, and logistics management in Japan. The company provides AnyAI, an AI platform for collecting, visualizing, and utilizing brand data; AnyLive, an AI live commerce platform; AnyX, an e-commerce management platform that enables centralized management of multiple e-commerce channels; AnyTag, an influencer marketing platform; AnyManager, a one-stop platform for web and app publishers; and AnyCreator, supports a various areas including content creation, monetization, and channel and account growth. It offers AnyLogi, a logistics management platform; AnyChat, a platform for customer engagement for buying opportunities; AnyShop, a platform to build and operate brand.com sites; AnyFactory, Platform that connects brands with manufacturers; and AnyDigital, a digital marketing platform that enables centralized management, including ad serving, and management and analysis of online and offline media. In addition, the company offers solutions for brands, publishers, and creators. The company was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. AnyMind Group Inc. operates as a subsidiary of AnyMind Group Pte Ltd.

SecondXight Analytica, Inc. provides analytics consulting services and AI products based on machine learning and deep learning in Japan. The company provides analytics-based consulting services that allow clients to build data analysis and machine learning models to solve specific business problems. It also offers R2Engine, a practical AI execution platform that supports large amounts of data processing; Analytics platform, a centralized data management and analysis platform; SX score,a scoring service without in-house data; SkyFox, a service that allows to build AI models ; and SkyFoxHR for Instantly score a huge number of entry sheets. SecondXight Analytica, Inc. was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

circlace Inc supports the introduction and operation of cloud systems and provides in-house developed cloud systems in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Consulting Business and Aora Now Business. It offers sales force services, including consulting, development and collaboration, implementation, operation and stabilization, and in-house development; and managed services. The company also provides Anaplan, a cloud service that supports all corporate planning and performance management tasks that enable to create various plans, such as personnel plans, budget plans, and sales plans, and manage the performance of each plan in areas comprising management accounting, sales, and supply chain management. In addition, it offers SaaS products, such as AGAVE Overseas Human Resources and Labor which allows for centralized management of individual profile information and task status, as well as streamlines the work of all parties involved; and AGAVE Overseas payroll that prevents incorrect operation of calculation formulas and input contents; and Overseas HR DX Consulting. Further, the company engages in digital transformation consulting; consulting on business improvement using ICT; and provision of design, development, establishment, maintenance, and operational support services. circlace Inc was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Moi Corporation engages in the live streaming communication platform business in Japan. It offers TwitCasting, a live broadcasting service for mobile; and Membership STAR, a fan community application. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

Nulab Inc. develops solution that promotes team collaboration. The company offers Backlog, a project and task management tool; Nulab Pass, a tool which strengthens your organization information security governance; Cacoo, a visual collaboration tool for organizing project ideas, website layouts, and work through online; and Nulab Flowbase, a workflow automation tool for teams. It also provides development, UX and design, small business and startups, marketing, information technology, product management, remote work, task management, client management, issue and bug tracking, agile project management, version control, online whiteboard, kanban, online slides, Gantt chart, email replacement, agency management software, asynchronous collaboration tools, bug reporting software, consultant management software, digital transformation tools, hybrid project management, operations management software, project portfolio management, production management software, resource management, service request management software, software development project management, sprint planning tools, and workflow management solutions. Nulab Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

unerry,Inc. operates real behavior data platforms in Japan. It offers Shopper Miel, a shopper analytics tool; Shopping congestion map, a tool that provides congestion tendency by day of the week and time zone near stores, such as supermarkets and drug stores; and Customized congestion map, a tool that automatically estimates store/event congestion. The company also provides Beacon Bank AD, a tool that optimizes advertising by identifying targets, timings, and locations that are likely to be visited and deliver real-time push and social media ads; Beacon Bank 1to1, a build integrated marketing platform; and Real behavior data visualization/analysis, a tool that provides AI analysis of accumulated monthly big data of approximately 84 billion people, and visualization and analysis. In addition, it offers advertising services. unerry,Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

HOUSEI Inc. engages in the information systems business in Japan and internationally. The company offers page production, advertising management, page management, and sales management for newspaper companies; production and editing software, layout management, and content management, and systems related to print publication for publishers; apps and cloud services; contract system development; IT engineer dispatch services for manufacturing, finance, and service industries; school report systems and automated grading software; product solution development and logistics; and IT services. It also provides software platforms, such as imprai ezBI, imprai, imprai ezCheck, Pixtock, British Spirit, eRESERvest, NOVO, WelcomID, Square Box, ezRepo, Customer IQ, Megalith, Dandelion, ezOrder Solution, Mobius, Bottle Keep Benrikun, ElecRoc6090 SP, SkyEdit IBIS automatic typesetting, FORE C, Founder Pack, EagleRIP Flexo 5.1, Advertising System, Bargain Manager Ver4.1, Fangzheng Chine outline font, Hoseiji Library, Halftone dots, DocuDefend, SuperLine, ElecRoc 5, FNP-X, Electronic Publishing, News Media Stand, and EagleDot. The company was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Japan Business Systems, Inc. provides cloud integration and related services. The company operates through three segments: Cloud Integration, Cloud Service, and License & Products. It develops, implements, establishes, and monitors cloud migration plans; implements Microsoft Cloud services; and offers maintenance, operation, and support services to enhance cloud utilization, focusing on Microsoft Cloud. The company also engages in the provision of cloud solutions, licenses, equipment for on-premise infrastructure, and private cloud services; and resale of related equipment. In addition, it offers Microsoft 365; Microsoft power platform; security; cloud manufacture solutions; hybrid meetings; global business support services; and Microsoft dynamics 365. Japan Business Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

eWeLL Co.,Ltd. provides cloud-based electronic power tool for home-based medical care in Japan. It provides iBow, a cloud-based electronic medical record system for visiting nursing stations covering all operational tasks; iBow Receipt, a receipt system dedicated to visiting nursing that has the function of making insurance claims; iBow KINTAI, an attendance management system for home nursing; iBow Administrative Management Services; iBow Nursing Care Claim Transmission Service; iBow_ equipped with an AI home nursing report; e-Rece, a factoring service for home nursing care; and iBow-Campus Visiting Nursing Legal Training Edition, an e-learning service. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Innovacell Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells cell therapy and regenerative medicine products. The company's products include ICEF15, a cell treatment for urgent fecal incontinence; ICEF16, a cell therapy for leaky fecal incontinence; and ICES13, a cell therapy for stress urinary incontinence. Innovacell Inc. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

Geekly, Inc. operates as an information technology recruitment company in Japan. The company operates as a recruitment agency specializing in the information technology, web, and gaming industries. Geekly, Inc. was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Tess Holdings Co.,Ltd. engages in the engineering and energy supply businesses in Japan. The company involved in the engineering, procurement, and construction of energy conservation and renewable energy-related facilities. It also engages in the operations and maintenance of renewable energy power plants and renewable energy power generation; energy management, remote monitoring, and fuel supply services, as well as energy resource aggregation services, including supply-demand adjustment capacity, imbalance avoidance, rate reduction, and output suppression avoidance to general power transmission and distribution operators, power retailers, and consumers. In addition, the company offers intelligent energy infrastructure. It has installed capacity of approximately 398.6 MW for renewable energy power generation facilities, including 127 solar power plants, and 3 biomass power plant. The company was formerly known as Tess Techno Service Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. in April 2018. Tess Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

INFRONEER Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides infrastructure services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Building Construction; Civil Engineering; and Paving. It provides constructed on work and related business for multi-dwelling complexes, factories and logistics centers, bridges and tunnels. The company is also involved in manufacturing and sale of asphalt mixture, and related businesses; providing construction work, including pavement; and sales and rental of construction machinery and related businesses. In addition, it engages in business investment in the development, operation, and maintenance; sale of solar and wind power generation projects; and concession projects, such as acquisition of operating rights for public infrastructure, etc. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

CEL Corporation provides consulting services on land utilization. The company also engages in the business related to design and construction, civil engineering works; property management, building leasing, and management and operations; real estate sales, leasing, exchange and its agency, and mediation; and building renovation and maintenance. In addition, it is involved in the business related to manufacturing and processing of steel components and materials, operates non-life insurance agency business and life insurance solicitation business; and provision of apartment management services. CEL Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Novac Co., Ltd. operates in the civil engineering and construction general contracting business in Japan. It maintains and repairs public facilities, tenant buildings, condominiums, etc. It also involved in the design and construction supervision of buildings; and landscaping and greening contracting businesses. Novac Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Himeji, Japan.

The Yokohama Rubber Company, Limited engages in the tire business in Japan, the United States, India, China, the Philippines, Europe and internationally. It operates through Tires and M.B. segments. The company offers tires for passenger cars, trucks and buses, light trucks, mining and construction equipment, industrial vehicles and agricultural and forestry machinery, aluminum alloy wheels, and automobile-related components. It also provides conveyor belts, rubber plates, various hoses, marine fenders, oil spill containment booms, marine hoses, rubber molded products, air springs, and aerospace products, as well as golf-related products and information processing services. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Hiratsuka, Japan.

Toyo Tire Corporation manufactures and sells tires in Japan, North America, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Tires and Automotive Parts. The company provides tires for passenger vehicles, lights trucks, cars, SUVs, and buses under the Toyo Tires and Nitto. It also offers automotive parts, including engine/motor, member/differential, strut, and exhaust mounts; bush/couplings and constant velocity universal joint boot; and anti-vibration rubbers cars. Toyo Tire Corporation was formerly known as Toyo Tire & Rubber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Toyo Tire Corporation in January 2019. The company was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Itami, Japan.

Bridgestone Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells tires and rubber products in Japan, China, India, the Asia Pacific, the United States, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers passenger car, motorcycle, trucks, buses, construction and mining vehicles, agricultural machinery, and aircraft tires; automotive components; automotive maintenance and repair services; synthetic rubber; retreading materials; and raw materials for tires. It also provides hoses, rubber crawler MT pads, resin piping, seismic isolation rubber, rubber bearings for bridges, and block-type rubber-coated chain bridge collapse prevention device. In addition, the company offers golf equipment comprising golf balls and golf clubs; bicycles and power-assisted bicycles; and finance services, including lending, factoring and entrusted processing of accounting and payroll calculation. Further, it provides retail and service, fleet, aviation, industrial and construction machinery, agriculture mobility, mining, and building solutions. Additionally, it engages in shipping and warehousing activities. Bridgestone Corporation was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides tires, sports, and industrial and other products in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells a range of tires for various vehicles, such as passenger cars, trucks, buses, motorcycles, construction vehicles, agricultural vehicles, and race and rally cars, as well as for industrial vehicles under the Dunlop and Falken brands. It also offers aluminum wheels; golf and tennis goods; rubber parts for medical applications and office equipment; vibration control dampers; floor coating; civil works and marine facilities; artificial turf for sporting facilities; rubber gloves; gas hoses; and portable wheelchair ramps, as well as sports products, such as golf clubs, tennis rackets, and other sporting gear. The company was formerly known as Dunlop Rubber Company (Far East) Ltd. and changed its name to Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. in 1963. Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1909 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber components in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Materials, Fabric Processing Products, Sporting Goods, and Other segments. The company manufactures and sells industrial materials, including pneumatic control equipment, anti-vibration table and peripheral equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, rescue and lifesaving equipment, and carbon golf shafts. It also offers gas/water housing equipment, connection materials, and materials for speakers. In addition, the company provides automobiles, such as check valves; automotive parts; calendared rubber; industrial equipment, including duct quarter vent rubber/butterfly, and BF and AB cylinders; calendared rubber, such as anti-vibration system, rubber coated fabric, and pressure regulator; ultra-low hardness material and anti-vibration rubber products; paper roll airbags; conductive rubber, and textile/material for clothing. Further, it offers emergency magnesium air batteries; blade protective sheets for wind turbine; various functional tapes and molded products, cold shrink tube, and conservators for electric; LIM molded products; dialyzers, infusion, and blood circuits; check valves; regulator; flow control valve; latex products; disaster-relief tents, air tents, and inflatable life rafts and jackets; golf shaft for golf clubs; caravan shoes for trekking, hiking, trail running, and nordic walking; stream walking and climbing; and climbing/bouldering shoes. The company was formerly known as Fujikura Rubber Ltd. and changed its name to FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. in April 2019. FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Okamoto Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells industrial and household products in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It offers industrial products, including plastic films for general goods, stationery; wallpaper for housing, decorative films for kitchen cabinets, doors, building materials, moldable ABS and acrylic sheets, and synthetic leather for sofas and furniture; automotive materials; agricultural films/work materials; and food wrapping films, absorbent/dehydrant sheets, gloves, and other food sanitation materials. The company also provides adhesive tapes and rubber bands; flexible container bags; medical/welfare products comprising wound dressing materials, medical gloves, autoclaves, masks, and other sanitary materials; and industrial products, such as cleanroom gloves, adhesive mats for entrances, partition films, safety shoes, and other products. In addition, it offers household products consisting of condoms/lubricants, heat patches/heating pads/hot water bags, health goods, portable sanitary products, and gloves; dehumidifiers, cockroach control products; absorbent/dehydrant sheets, food wrapping films, and sheets for cooking; rubber boots, safety shoes, and marine wear; and leather shoes and sneakers. Further, the company engages in the logistics and solar power generation business. Okamoto Industries, Inc. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

Fines inc. provides video production services in Japan. It offers video distribution platform; marketing data centralized management tools; and DX consulting; and reskilling training and e-learning services, as well as security solutions. The company also provides online reservation systems. Fines inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

PORTERS Corporation develops and provides cloud solutions for the human resources business in Japan. The company operates through the HR Tech Business and Global HR Tech Business segments. It offers PORTERS, a cloud-based comprehensive matching management system for recruitment agencies, temporary staffing companies, and other companies involved in human resources matching services. It also provides various support services, such as data migration, screen optimization tuning, various setting support, consulting for introduction support, and data maintenance services. In addition, the company offers API functions for linking with other systems or in-house systems, as well as publishes Porter's magazines. Its solutions include various functions, such as job seeker/resume management, client/recruitment management, interview scheduler, selection process management, matching functions, customization, media cooperation, import and export of data, and homepage linkage, as well as the creation of one-click forms, and reports and dashboards. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

FIXER Inc. engages in the development of application systems on cloud platforms in Japan. It offers new system development and cloud migration of existing systems; resale of cloud service licenses; and manage services. The company also develops SaaS business. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Linkers Corporation engages in business matching and research in Japan. The company offers Linkers Sourcing, a service which searches for companies, universities, and experts to solve technological challenges in the manufacturing industry; and Linkers Marketing for opportunities for meetings with companies that show interest. It also provides Linkers for BANK/Business, a SaaS-based business matching systems; Linkers Research, which conducts research into various technical fields; and TechMesse Academy, a coordination of technology service promotion events. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

pluszero, Inc. engages in the provision, development, maintenance, operation, and sale of solutions that integrate AI, natural language processing, software, hardware, and other technologies in Japan. The company offers task-specific services, such as OCR's+ that read and recognize documents and drawings to automate and enhance business processes; a chatbot for responding to customer questions and applications; CRM optimization for website/app management and sales activities; check job ads; privacy-preserving data mining, which enables secure utilization of personal information; and electronic voting platform solution. It also supports research activities and administrative work of universities, companies, and professional organizations, including NLP annotation services and student performance evaluation system; and provides consulting services. The company was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Terilogy Holdings Corporation provides cyber security solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates through Network Category, Security Division, and Solution Services Division segments. The company It also provides switches, routers, wireless LAN, and DNS/DHCP equipment; designs and constructs enterprise information and communication systems and infrastructure services; network operation, management, monitoring equipment and its own cloud performance monitoring services; professional services; maintenance of networks, ancillary equipment and software; cyber threat intelligence intelligent security services; firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention, information leakage measures, etc.; and security authentication infrastructures. In addition, the company offers one-time password products; log management and analysis cloud services; maintenance of security equipment and software products; software RPA tool (EzAvater); multilingual video interpretation services; cloud-managed VPN service; and web conferencing services. Further, it provides internet connection service for businesses; mobile data communication service; promotional businesses; and Information system development and operation services, as well as DX technologies. The company was formerly known as Terilogy Co., Ltd. Terilogy Holdings Corporation was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

POPER Co.,Ltd. provides a business management platform for educational institutions in Japan. The company offers Comiru, a SaaS-type business management platform that streamlines back-office operations of educational businesses. It also engages in developing BITCAMPUS, a platform that provides management suffort system for the cram school industry; ComiruAir, online classes and home learning support service; ComiruBASIC, a platform that improves operational efficiency; ComiruPay, which streamlines billing and payment operations; and ComiruHR, a labor management and communication service for instructors. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

tripla Co., Ltd. engages in travel agency and internet service business in Japan, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers triplaBook, a booking engine for hotels; triplaBot, an AI chatbot for marketing and promotion; tripla Pay, an email-linked payment service collects cancellation fees; triplalink, a tool for overbookings and to manage accommodation reservations through online channels; and triplasuccess, which reduce workload by supporting facility management. It provides also triplaboost; metasearch, advertising management services; triplaGuide, which information to guests during their stay at a hotel; triplaConnect, a CRM/MA tool for the hospitality industry; tripla analytics, a BI service; and tripla page that creates official websites in multiple languages without coding. The company serves accommodation facilities and internet users. tripla Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

SmartDrive inc. engages in the development of data platforms and services that support the evolution of mobility services in Japan. It offers SmartDrive Fleet, a cloud-based vehicle management system; streamlining service creations; and SmartDrive Mobility Data Platform that utilizes various devices such as, dashcams and GPS trackers for use in various mobility services. The company also develops and provides hardware, applications, and telematics services, as well as data collection and analysis services. SmartDrive inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

OpenWork Inc. develops and manages a job and recruitment information platform in Japan. The company operates OpenWork, a one-stop job and recruitment information platform incorporating company reviews and salary information; OpenWork Recruiting, a direct scouting service; and Job Satisfaction LAB, which publishes various job- and recruitment-related reports, as well as offers analysis and reporting services to support companies' management and organizational development. It also provides alternative data services on Japanese companies. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. OpenWork Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Link and Motivation Inc.

Achilles Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of shoes, plastic products, and industrial materials in Japan and internationally. It offers construction and civil engineering products, including heat insulation materials, interior materials, landscaping materials, plumbing material, and civil engineering materials; manufacturing and facilities products, such as films and sheets, rubberized fabrics, soft urethane foam, expanded polystyrene foam, and rim molding for large scale molding; and electrical machinery and electronics comprising anti-static products, packaging materials for wafers and electronic device, and conductive materials. The company also provides vehicle accessories, including synthetic and vinyl chloride leather, and laminated goods; and agriculture and livestock products, such as greenhouse horticulture materials and building materials for agriculture and livestock. In addition, it offers disaster prevention and lifesaving, as well as evacuation shelter support products; living and leisure products comprising household items and inflatable boats; and shoes under the MEDIFOAM, ALL DAY Walk, SYUNSOKU, Achilles SORBO, and MONTRRE brands. Achilles Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Nishikawa Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber and sealing products in Japan, North America, East Asia, and Southeast Asia. It offers automotive-related products, such as door outer seal, door inner seal, back door seal, door hole seal, grass run channel, waist seal, food seal, charging port sticker, convertible header, convertible roof side, and door outer seal for convertibles. The company also provides housing-related products, including joint gaskets and sealing backup material; civil engineering-related products, such as flexible joints for sewerage systems; and cosmetic related products comprising makeup puff, konjac sponge, and hiroshima lemon puffs. Nishikawa Rubber Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

Asahi Rubber Inc. manufactures and sells industrial, and medical and sanitary rubber products in Japan. It operates through Industrial Rubber Business, and Medical and Sanitary Rubber Business segments. The company offers optical products, including ASA COLOR LED and ASACOLOR LED-EMMO, which are light source products; ASA COLOR LENS, a silicone lens solution; white silicone inks; light diffusion caps/color caps; and lamp caps for automotive interior lighting, as well as phosphor sheet/tubes. It also provides medical/life science products comprising silicone sheets, medical gaskets, check valves, and rubber plugs; and communication products, such as silicone rubber phantoms and soft protective covers. In addition, the company offers automotive rubber switches; flexible thermoelectric modules; products for wind turbine blades that include plasma actuators, divertor strips, and protective sheeting and shells; and molecular adhesion technology products, saporous foams, O-rings, and rubber for table tennis rackets. Asahi Rubber Inc. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Nichirin Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive and housing hoses, and related parts in Japan and internationally. The company offers braking, hydraulic and pneumatic hoses for automobiles and motorcycles; rubber and resin hoses; and piping for heat management and hot and cold-water supply services. It also provides automotive hoses, including those for steering, braking, and air conditioning systems, as well as hose assemblies and piping for large trucks and buses. It also manufactures and sells products for non-automotive sectors, such as home appliances and housing equipment, and components for electric vehicles. Nichirin Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Fukoku Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber, metal and synthetic resin, and bio and medical related products in Japan, Southeast Asia, India, the United States, Europe, China, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through the Functional Products Business, Anti-Vibration Business, Life Sciences Business, Metal Processing Business, and Hose Business segments. The company offers wiper blade rubbers that are used in automobiles, railways, ships, and aircrafts; and seal products, which are used in automobiles, pneumatic devices, and industrial machinery. It also provides anti-vibration products comprising suspensions, rotating systems, and engine accessories for automobiles; shock absorbers and railroad track pads for railcars; and construction and industrial machinery. In addition, the company offers standard, semi-custom, and nonmagnetic ultrasonic motors; and ultrasonic atomizer products. Further, the company provides cell culture bag products; OA-related products, such as digital photo printer rollers and pads, and ink jet printer components; urethane products and microchannel chips; dampers, mounts, and urethane; metal parts for trucks and construction machinery; and hoses and other rubber products. The company was formerly known as Fukoku Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fukoku Co.,Ltd. in January 1986. Fukoku Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

Nitta Corporation engages in the provision of power transmission belts, conveyor belts and units, and other products in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Belt and Rubber Products Business; Hose and Tube Product Business; Chemical Products Business; Other Industrial Products Business; Real Estate Business; and Management Guidance Business. It offers power transmission and conveyor belts, including PolySprint, Polybelt, and Super Endless belts; curve belt list; and conveyor units, such as curve, spiral, non-snaking, and junction conveyor systems. It also provides Hose and tube products comprising thermoplastic hoses and couplings, tubing and tube fittings, clean tube fittings, speed controllers and valves, and disconnect couplings; and industrial wipers and molded rubber products. In addition, the company offers air and chemical filters; filter casting and clean system equipment; bacteria decontamination equipment; particle and microorganism measuring instruments. Further, it provides mechatronics products, including automatic tool changers and interface units; Intelimer tapes; and RFID magnetic sheets. Additionally, the company offers SOFTmatics, a robot hand used for handling objects; and thermoplastic tubes, tubes and fittings for air brakes, and air spring. The company also engages in leasing land and buildings, and management consulting services; and offers polishing pads and slurry, and construction and waterproofing materials. It serves civil engineering and construction, automobile, logistic and transportation, environment and energy, industrial machinery, semiconductor, liquid crystal and electronic components, food, medicine, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Nitta Belting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nitta Corporation in 1982. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Create Medic Co., Ltd. engages in the research, manufacturing, and sale of medical appliances in Japan, China, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers urology products, including all silicone foley, antibacterial foley, hematuria, tieman, suprapubic, and nephrostomy balloon catheters, as well as self-catheterization set, all silicone self-catheter for replacement, pure-cath, nephrostomy kit, cystostomy set, and all silicone malecot catheter; and gastroenterology products, such as all silicone ileus, stomach, and sengstaken blakemore tubes, as well as transanal ileus decompression tube set. It also provides PEG products comprising PEG kit pull-method, with loop fixture, and bumper type, as well as CLINY introducer PEG kit, loop fixture II, all silicone gastrostomy balloon catheter for replacement, balloon button set, facil button for replacement, gastrostomy replacement catheter set, all silicone PEG J catheter, and transgastric jejunal balloon tube and guidewire set; surgery products, which include PTC drainage tube, PTCD kit, cholangio-entero tube, and internal external drainage catheter for PTCD; all silicone endotracheal and tracheostomy tubes and micro catheter; and OEM products. The company was formerly known as NASK Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Create Medic Co., Ltd. in July 1977. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty rubber products. The company offers firefighting products, including fire hoses, firefighting suction hoses, toxic substances measuring instruments, firefighting training and rescue apparatus, air respirators, emergency life saving tools, powered impact tools, air lifting bags, community disaster prevention apparatus, couplings for large diameter hoses, MVU fans and blowers, and rescue support systems, as well as mountain, hydraulic, and water rescue tools. It also provides aerospace products, such as various tube assemblies; PTFE hoses, rubber, lightweight hoses, dynatube fittings, AM products, machine parts, metal hoses, molded and extruded rubber, silicone and chloroprene rubber ducts, rubber sheets, inflatable rubber seals, thermal insulations, honeycomb mats, and Parker-Stratoflex division products. In addition, the company offers industrial rubber products comprising tank vapor seals; oil-resistant hoses for petrochemical plants; suction delivery hoses; tank lorry hoses; gate seals; joints; rubber sheets; pressed products; molded rubber; and insulation hoses for hydroelectric dams and levees. Further, it engages in the real estate business, such as operation of shopping malls. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. manufactures and sells belts and construction materials in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automobile and motorcycle transmission belts and related products, such as timing belts, variable speed belts, v-ribbed belts, raw edge v-belts, worm wheels, and accessory drive systems; and industrial power transmission belts and related products, including v-belts for general industry and agricultural machinery, timing belts for general industry, RIBSTAR belts, polyurethane belts, FLEXSTAR belts, pulleys, and couplings. It also provides conveyer belts, systems, and related products comprising mamaline, LOGISTAR, and tailormade solutions; and engineering plastic materials and processed products, such as molecular weight and density polyethylene, cast-nylon, clean-PE products, polyacetal, polyetheretherketone, polyphenylenesulfide, and polytetrafluoroethylene. In addition, the company offers waterproofing materials for construction and related products; civil engineering water-shielding materials; electronic and coating materials consisting of conductive, metal, glass, pastes, and resistive pastes; copper sintering paste, cushioning materials, thick film solutions, metallized ceramic substrates, via-filling solutions, and decorative paints; and star wipers. It serves to automobile, two-wheelers, agriculture/forestry, industrial machinery, robot, money handling machine, logistics/transportation, construction/civil engineering, semiconductor/battery, food, medical/health, life, amusement, energy, printer, environment, and society applications. The company was formerly known as Mitsuboshi Chotai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. in May 1961. Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. was founded in 1919 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Sagami Rubber Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies condoms. The company offers polyurethane and latex condoms, external catheters, and probe covers; plastic films; and healthcare products and services. It sells its products in Japan, France, Switzerland, Italy, Portugal, Spain, Finland, Norway, Sweden, Korea, Vietnam, Mexico, and the United States. Sagami Rubber Industries Co., Ltd. was founded in 1934 and is headquartered in Atsugi, Japan.

Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufactures and sale of automotive parts, industrial materials and high-performance elastomer products in Japan, China, Asia, Europe, America, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Auto Parts Business, Industrial Materials Business, and High-Performance Elastomer Products business. It offers automotive power transmission belt products, such as power transmission belts and power transmission systems for auxiliary drive systems; motorcycle power transmission belt products; scooter gear shift belts, etc. The company also provides industrial power transmission belt products, such as industrial machinery V-belts, toothed belts, pulleys, etc.; other power transmission products; conveyor belts comprising resin conveyor belts, synchronous conveying belts; conveyor system products; and rice hulling rolls, etc. In addition, it offers cleaning blades, rollers, precision belts, polyurethane functional parts, precision polishing materials, films for construction materials, medical films, decorative display films, industrial films, and other products. In addition, it offers friction power transmission belts, synchronous power transmission belts, conveyor belts related products, light duty conveyance product, scraping sealing products, tension gauge sensor, resin products, film products, optical sheets cleaning systems, polishing materials, thermal management products, and other products. Further, the company provides robot-related devices, electronic materials, and medical equipment. Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of rubber products and precision equipment in Japan, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Medical Equipment; Precision Medical Devices; SP Business; and Food Container. The company offers shock and helical vibration absorbers; gas springs; and plastic, vane, and rotary dampers. It also provides condoms, balloons, and related latex products, as well as industrial purpose buffer products. In addition, it manufactures and sales food grade rubber containers, filing machines, and related products. Further, the company provides probe covers, intrauterine contraceptives, cervical dilators, and related products for medical sector. The company was formerly known as Japan Latex Industry Co., Ltd and changed its name to Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. in July 1961. Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Basic Inc. develops SaaS platform and digital solutions for the B2B marketing field. The company's products include ferret One, a B2B marketing tool for creating websites and managing leads; formrun, a no-code form builder with simple customer management functions; bookrun, a scheduling tool for coordinating appointments; workrun, an AI-based workflow tool for automating basic tasks; and AIBOW, an AI agent system that supports routine operational work. Basic Inc. was founded in 2004 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.

AGC Inc. manufactures and sells architectural glass, electronics, chemicals, automotive, and ceramics worldwide. The company offers architectural glass products, including insulated, laminated, wired, toughened, solar control, sound insulation, decorative, float and patterned, and industrial glass, as well as structural glazing systems and industrial glass; automotive glass for displays, sensors and connected drive, windows, and trains; and glass substrates used for thin-film-transistor liquid crystal displays and OLEDs. It also provides synthetic fused silica glass, silicon carbides, CMP slurry, and through glass vias, and glass substrates for semiconductor packaging and anodic bonding; industrial PTFE composite materials and copper clad laminate; optical materials comprising high refractive index glass, DOE diffuser, wave plates, IR cut filter, aspherical glass lenses, micro lens array, and transmission grating; optical film, such as antireflection film, beam splitter, and interference filter; glass frit, pastes, and lid for hermetic sealing; tissue culture products; laboratory glassware; borosilicate glass tubes and rods; and heat resistant glassware. In addition, the company offers chlor-alkali, polyurethanes, fluoro, and specialty chemical products; high thermal insulation ceramics wall for furnaces and fine ceramics; and plasma-resistant coating for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and plastic optical fiber. Further, it provides contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical and agrochemical components. The company was formerly known as Asahi Glass Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AGC Inc. in July 2018. AGC Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of glass and glass products in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company operates through Architectural, Automotive, Technical Glass, and Other segments. It offers flat glass and various interior and exterior glazing products within commercial and residential markets; and glass for the solar energy sector. The company also provides automotive products, including front and rear door, front and rear quarter, and front and rear vent glasses; and windshield, sunroof, and rear window glasses; and distributes glass for light, medium and heavy duty commercial vehicles, as well as off-road vehicles, bus and coach, and marine and rails. In addition, it offers information and telecommunication devices; functional products under the MICROGLAS brand name; and fine glass products, such as thin sheets, special glass for chemical strengthening, and anti-glare glass products. The company was formerly known as America Japan Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited in 1931. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

J-Pharma Co., Ltd. is engaged in the research and development of pharmaceutical drugs in Japan. The company researches and develops drugs targeting solute carrier (SLC) transporters, with emphasis on the LAT1 amino acid transporter. It is developing several compounds for various medical indications, including nanvuranlat (JPH203), a novel small-molecule compound identified as a selective inhibitor of LAT1 and provide treatment for biliary tract cancer, as well as for colorectal cancer; JPH034 is characterized as high brain penetrance and development for disorders of the central nervous system, including non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis and glioma; and JPT-0008 for solid tumor, autoimmune diseases, and rare diseases. It also conducting clinical trail for biliary tract cancer and JPH034. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Nihon Yamamura Glass Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of glass bottles in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Glass Bottle Related Business; Plastic Container Related Business; Logistics Related Business; and New Glass Related Business. It offers glass bottles for sake, wine, whiskey, shochu, beer, food, seasonings, soft beverages, milk, chemicals, and other drinks; and sintering additive and general glass, glaze and overcoat glass, high heat resistance crystalized glass, and LTCC materials. The company is also involved in the manufacturing of plastic caps and other related products; and logistics business, including transportation, storage, and on-site operations. Nihon Yamamura Glass Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

Nippon Electric Glass Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells specialty glass products and glass glassmaking machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers glass products for LCD/OLED displays and optoelectronics, chemical, and lighting; and ultra-thin glass, glass wafers for supporting semiconductors, glass substrates for probe cards, LTCC products, functional glass powders, cover glass for image sensors, and glass tubes for small electronic components. It also provides chopped strands for functional plastics reinforcement, wet chopped strands for building materials, roving for plastics reinforcement, chopped-strand mats for automobiles, and alkali-resistant glass fibers for cement reinforcement. In addition, the company offers glass tubing for pharmaceutical and medical use, radiation shielding glass, super heat-resistant glass-ceramics, fire-rated glass, glass blocks, and glass-ceramic building materials. Its products are used in televisions, displays, smartphones, automotive displays, electronic components, optical communication, buildings, civil engineering, fire-resistant glass, medical containers, and cooktop surfaces applications, as well as observation and operation windows in CT/angiography rooms. Further, the company provides solutions to healthcare, aerospace, semiconductor, infrastructure, glass engineering, automotive, information and communication, and housing equipment and building materials. Nippon Electric Glass Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Otsu, Japan.

Kuramoto Co., Ltd. engages in the development, processing, and sale of glass substrates in Japan. The company offers glass substrate processing, cutting, chamfering, and polishing. It also involved into quartz component repair clinic; DX lark partner; perovskite solar cell; AI camera; and cleaning robot businesses. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Kurihara, Japan.

Ohara Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of glass materials for optical and electronics equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers optical glass products for polished lenses and molded aspherical lenses; glass-ceramic products under the CLEARCERAM-Z, WMS-15, and NANOCERAM names; and GD-FHT, a glass disk for use in flying height testers. It also provides LICGC SP-01 membranes; LICGC PW 01 powders; i-line high homogeneity glass and non-browning glass products; and fiber glasses for light guide. Ohara Inc. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cement and related products primarily in Japan. It operates through six segments: Cement, Mineral Products, Building Materials, Optoelectronics, New Materials, and Others. The company offers cement, cement-based solidification materials, electric power supply, recycling, and ready-mix concrete; limestone for steelmaking, road construction, aggregate, calcium carbonate, dolomite, antibacterial agents, cosmetic materials, various functional paints, and silica powder; optical communication components and measuring equipment; and ceramic products and nanoparticle materials. It is also involved in repair and reinforcement materials for concrete structures, heavy metal pollution control materials, cathodic protection (ELGARD SYSTEM), and fish reefs and seaweed beds; and real estate leasing, information processing services, and electrical construction work which utilize idle land. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Taiheiyo Cement Corporation engages in the cement, mineral resources, environmental, construction materials, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, and internationally. Its Cement segment offers ordinary portland cement, specialty cement, soil stabilizers, and ready-mixed concrete. The Mineral Resources segment sells limestone aggregate products comprising course and fine aggregate used in ready-mixed concrete, and aggregate used in concrete products and civil engineering; sandstone and andesite as aggregate materials; quicklime, slaked lime, filler, silica, and silica powder; and hollow ceramics, sepiolite, wollastonite, and kaolin. Its Environmental segment recycles used tires, waste plastics, paper sludge, waste casting sand, other industrial waste, surplus soil from water purification, sewage sludge, dredging sludge, and other wastes discarded from municipalities, as well as engages in the CFC treatment and building waste treatment plants; develops and commercializes environmental recycling technologies, including ash washing system and applied kiln system, and fermentation technology; supplies flue gas desulfurization materials, such as calcium carbonate; and sells slag powder and other inorganic materials, coal, heavy oil, and other fuels, as well as chemicals and gypsum. The Construction Materials segment produces precast concrete products; promenades, interlocking blocks, and concrete housing products; acoustic panels used to reduce construction noise; and fireproof covering materials used in tunnels. Its Other Businesses segment leases land for office buildings, commercial stores, leisure facilities, distribution warehouses, and other structures, as well as develops land for residential housing; and engages in the data processing, transportation and warehouse, engineering, chemical products, and sports business. Taiheiyo Cement Corporation was incorporated in 1881 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

SEIWA HOLDINGS Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells highway signs; and fabricates inspection lanes and steel brackets. The company also provides electro-galvanizing and zinc plating services for elevators and industrial machinery; designs and installs steel structures; sells various industrial machinery, etc.; and manufactures and sells electric wires and cables, generator and engine covers for ships, vacuum rubber molding machines, molding assist and bio-related equipment, and liquid level gauge and sight glass. It also engages in the painting of metal automotive parts; and plating of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and machine tool parts. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

monoAI technology Co.,Ltd. provides metaverse, and XR event and peripheral services in Japan. It offers XR CLOUD that allows for easy hosting of events in virtual spaces; monoXR; mono QA; monobit engine; and AI implementation support services. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

long_name: Nihon Office Automation Research Co., Ltd.

business_summary: EYEZ,INC. operates various advertising industry platforms in Japan. It operates Media Radar, an advertising industry platform; Tramy, a word-of-mouth marketing platform; Cloud Radar, a cloud service platform; and Global Radar, a global countermeasure service platform. The company also operates Weekle, an activity platform; mamaPRESS, an information media for mothers; and Tramaga, an information media for women, as well as provides advertising agency services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

note inc. engages in the media platform, and IP content and content creation business in Japan. The company offers note, a C2C content platform that allows creators to create, publish, and sell digital content while communicating with users; note pro, an information dissemination SaaS for corporations; note money, a platform which provides financial, articles, and investment information; and services for corporations, such as organizing corporate sponsored contests on note. It is also involved in production and sales, as well as planning and content production contracts from external companies. The company was formerly known as Piece of Cake, Inc. and changed its name to note inc. in April 2020. note inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

jig.jp Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, and provision of mobile-centric software in Japan. It offers Fuwatch, a software solution that allows anyone to distribute and watch videos and radio; jigbrowser, a full browser application for viewing PC sites from mobile phones; open data platform, a service that allows to publish open data with Excel; and Ichigo Jam, a computer application for use in programming for children and beginners. It also provides VTuber business provides vtuber related services; Pecotter, a service that makes reservations for restaurants across Japan via chat; and Topia, a virtual music live streaming app. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

ELEMENTS, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides data-based personal authentication and optimization solutions as backend-as-a-service to service providers across various industries in Japan. The company offers LIQUID eKYC and Polarise eKYC, an online identity verification service; LIQUID Auth, an authentication service; PASS, a digital identity wallet; GPASS, a digital ID wallet for foreigners; office diagnostic report, which is a digital transformation service for office relocation and renovation; MyPlace for Home, a smart home/smart city platform; my IDEAL, a size matching service; Coordware, a personalized marketing for E-Commerce using generative AI; ELEMENTS cloud, a GPU cloud for AI development; and AiQ PERMISSION, an AI automatic refueling permit monitoring system. It also engages in the research and development of image recognition engines and data analysis platforms; offers optimization service for office living environment and biometric authentication service; and engages in construction of cloud environment construction and data center operation business, as well as engages in healthcare, web advertising, and medical supply business. ELEMENTS, Inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

BTM, Inc. provides IT engineering and DX solution services in Japan. The company offers human resources services. It also provides consulting and development results for system development projects. It also offers cloud services, network equipment, servers, PCs, etc. The company was formerly known as Business Total Management Co., Ltd. and changed its name to BTM, Inc. in September 2017. BTM, Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. BTM, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of GigaCloud Technology Inc.

TECHNOLOGIES, Inc. provides IT solutions in the areas of AI and entertainment software fields in Japan. The company is involved in HD business; development of AI and SaaS-related services; provision of design planning and programming planning, hardware and software development, progress management, video production services. It also engages in the renewable energy business; decarbonization and SDGs projects; and sports DX business. In addition, the company develops a prototype of an autonomous driving app, AI learning robot for children, automotive remote control system, live streaming app, projection mapping videos, 3D signage/motion authentication system, entertainment software, and game applications. The company was formerly known as BEL AIR Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TECHNOLOGIES, Inc. in May 2022. TECHNOLOGIES, Inc. was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

GMO Prime Strategy Co.,Ltd. provides cloud integration services in Japan. Its products include the KUSANAGI ultra-fast CMS platform and WEXAL page speed technology. The company provides KUSANAGI Managed Services, an integrated system for website maintenance and management of applications, middleware, and servers; CMS Platform integration services; WEXAL mobile display acceleration service; and hyper automation implementation services. It also provides cloud integration services, such as performance tuning; deployment of security tools, such as WAF, intrusion detection, antivirus; wordpress (website) construction and modification; and migration from various CMS to WordPress and Always On SSL. The company was formerly known as Prime Strategy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to GMO Prime Strategy Co.,Ltd. in February 2026. The company was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. GMO Prime Strategy Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of FinTech Global Incorporated.

Nihon Knowledge Co,Ltd. provides software system verification services, contract system development and business package development in Japan. It engages in the provision of software testing support; test automation support, such as test automation implementation consulting, support services, seminar, and methods for mobile devices; proprietary exploratory testing; business process automation support; and quality improvement support. The company also offers PowerSteel package for steel industry; Power Cubic, a package for building materials and lumber wholesale industry; DEFESA Logger complete synchronization of text logs and video data; DEFESA REC, a recording solution; monoPack, a security product; and mono + WEB Separation, a web separation solution. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

COVER Corporation distribute videos and music through VTubers distribution platform in Japan. It also develops characters and anime-look avatars; plans and produces events; and offers video content, such as live streams, music videos, and animations through video distribution, as well as membership subscriptions, advertising, and promotions services. In addition, the company is involved in the electronic commerce, VTuber production, and media mix businesses, plan and develop of merchandise, licenses/tie-ins, comics, animation and other activities; and development of Metaverse Holoearth, focusing on sandbox games that allow users to act freely in a virtual space. COVER Corporation was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Minato, Japan.

Arent Inc. develops SaaS based solutions for construction industry in Japan. It offers Lightning BIM software for architecture and structure industry; PlantStream software for plant/piping and plants/process applications; PROCOLLA, a cloud-based progress management system; BizGenie, a generative AI platform, PlantStream Aide, a plant piping design; BUILD, a structural design; Genba Navi Progress Management, a process management, Genba Navi 3D Rebar, a reinforcement design; Shinsekai-kun F Series, an administrative registration; Dot Genka Series, a cost management system; Tsukaeru Cloud Construction Ledger; Tsukaeru Cloud Work Attendance Management; and Let's Cost Management Go2 Series. It also provides consulting and system development services. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Monstarlab Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the information technology business in the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. It operates in two segments, Digital Consulting Business and Others. The company offers application and system, website, and e-commerce platform development, as well as AI and XR feature integration, API development and integration, and customer data platform implementation; and data warehouse, data integration infrastructure, and cloud application and infrastructure development, as well as legacy system modernization, digital twin implementation, and customer relationship management implementation. It also provides user research and strategic planning, ideation, service concept and customer journey design, prototyping, and implementation support and performance evaluation; visual identity, communication, and visual design, as well as brand concept development; and user interface and information architecture design, expert usability review, UX writing, and building a design system. In addition, the company offers idea generation support, strategic business planning, global and local market opportunity analysis, technology sourcing, and PoC/MVP development support; and digital transformation planning and support, digital infrastructure optimization, AI-driven and smart process transformation implementation, data-driven management promotion, and exploration of emerging markets and customer segments. Further, it is involved in offshore development, agile development implementation, maintenance and operations outsourcing, and provision of experts; and talent development program, skill transfer support, business process optimization, and implementation of workflow automation tools. The company was formerly known as Monstarlab Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Monstarlab Inc. in March 2025. Monstarlab Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Fusic Co., Ltd. operates as a technology company in Japan. The company offers cross-technology services, including cloud environment construction, system development, IoT data collection, and AI data analysis; maintenance and operation of systems and cloud environments; and resale of public clouds. It also provides web systems; smartphone apps; AI and machine learning; IoT systems; cloud infrastructure, and technology consulting.
