In addition, the company offers 360, a personal feedback tool to solve personnel issues; and sigfy, a communication service to receive messages in various ways. Fusic Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

Nova System Co.,Ltd. provides system integration for business system development, and cloud services. The company offers system integration; and develops system for various fields, including logistics, energy, trading companies, government agencies, and local authorities. It also provides cloud products, including Order Revolution, a restaurant management support system; iWelco, a reception support system; and iWelcotor, an access control system using AI facial recognition. In addition, the company offers ordering systems and POS systems for restaurants; and reception system for unmanned visitor handling and infection control. Nova System Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Transaction Media Networks Inc. provides electronic payment and information processing solutions in Japan. The company also offers cashless payment solutions to a range of businesses, including supermarkets, convenience stores, and gas stations. In addition, it provides house electronic money services; nextore, a payment-driven DX service platform for small and medium-sized businesses; cashless payment service business; cloud point of sale solutions; and marketing tools. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the hotel and golf operation businesses in Japan. It operates through six segments: Hotel Operation Business, Golf Operation Business, RESOL NO MORI Business, Welfare Business, Renewable Energy Business, and Investment Recovery Business. The company operates RESOL NO MORI sports and do resort, which provides relaxation, health, sports, and outdoor activities; golf courses; Fairway front Villa; and tourist hotels under the RESOL HOTELS brand name. It also engages in development of solar power generation facilities; provision of Life Support Club, a welfare services; and investment recovery business. The company was formerly known as Resort Solution Co., Ltd. and changed its name to RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in October 2016. RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Hume Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of pipes and concrete piles in Japan. It offers pipeline products, such as fume tubes and synthetic steel pipes, box and arch culverts, assembly manholes, precast joint grooves, wellman products, jacking internal pressure pipes, propulsion tubes, and antibacterial concrete products; concrete piles; RC segments; and PC and composite wells, and press casts and PRC hollow piers. The company also provides multi-arch systems, precast guard fences, EMC wall railings, and wall railings; and valve boxes, infiltration box culverts, precast flood control basin, and eco concrete products. In addition, the company offers connect holes, precast basements, and other concrete products. Further, it is involved in the construction contracts, optical fiber cable laying, rehabilitation, earthquake resistance, and real estate businesses. The company was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Asahi Concrete Works Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells concrete products in Japan. The company offers PC box, HTC Box, PRC box, large multi-section box, and PPCa box culvert, as well as box culvert for jacking construction; PC rainwater storage tank agua, new box-type agua, box culvert type rainwater storage tank, and PCa open regulating pond. It also provides emergency toilets; connecting halls, infiltration hall, and floating suppressing connect holes; waterways; fire prevention water tank; underground garage; railway and road related products; and hume pipes, PODs, underwater observation facilities, and amphibious vehicle access ramps. Asahi Concrete Works Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Concrete Industries Co., Ltd. design, construct, maintain, and sell concrete products. The company offers single and flange poles for infrastructure, such as power lines, telecommunication lines, mobile phone base stations, and electric railroads, as well as for lifestyle, including sports net poles, disaster radio poles, lighting poles, speaker poles, carp streamer support poles, wind power generation support poles, and drying poles for firefighting hoses; and pole accessories. It also precast concrete walls; and piles for construction, piles for civil construction, pile joint, pile head treatment, and geothermal power system. In addition, the company offers civil engineering products, such as tunnel shield and lining materials, box culverts, earth bracing retaining walls, ground anchors, concrete manholes and hand-holes, concrete walls for railway bridges, ultra-high-strength fiber-reinforced concrete, and precast concrete floor panels and construction materials; environmental materials; and soundproof materials, sound absorber and proof panels, and silencers. It operates in Japan and Myanmar. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Toyo Asano Foundation Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and installation of concrete piles in Japan. Its products include pre-stressed concrete piles, high-strength prestressed reinforced concrete piles, and concrete piles with outer steel pipe. The company also engages in the real estate leasing business. Toyo Asano Foundation Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Numazu, Japan.

Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells concrete products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Concrete Secondary Products-Related Business; Information-Related Business; and Others. The company offers pile products, including prestressed concrete, PRC, and SC piles, as well as construction management equipment and system, triple plate joints, and coupling and F.T. pile construction products; prestressed concrete poles and diameter poles; and waterwork materials, such as shake and surf blocks, surf flats and steps, surf flats L types, and tine block S types. It also provides gravel and stones for civil engineering construction, railway tracking and pavement roadbed materials, raw concrete, various concrete secondary products, aggregate of asphalt composite material, and construction materials; solar/pile systems; and environmental products comprising VS lateral grooves, L type retaining walls, block holding walls, box culverts, flumes, and H-form PC piles. In addition, the company is involved in hotel operation; office building rental; information-related solutions; and environmental hygiene businesses. Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

Nihon Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the civil engineering, landscaping, and exterior design businesses in Japan. The company designs and manufactures concrete products, including box culvert, culvert, retaining wall, road, underground cables, waterway, river, ocean, special concrete, and dam related products used for roads, sewer, bank construction, artificial reef, disaster prevention and mitigation, as well as the maintenance and repair of infrastructure, such as highways, bridges, and tunnels. It also offers paving materials, furniture used in parks, wood cleats, construction products, and disaster prevention and mitigation items. In addition, the company provides gardening and pet-related products comprising garden sink, shower place, standing faucet unit, disaster prevention and mitigation, entrance and approach, around the garden, parking, raku shiba, exterior related materials, and other exterior products. Further, it manufactures and sells products for public spaces; and undertakes evil engineering and block construction. Nihon Kogyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Sanuki, Japan.

Yoshicon Co.,Ltd. engages in the buying, sale, intermediation, leasing, management, and research of real estate properties in Japan. It also sells patent, utility model, design, and trust beneficiary rights; and construction and environmental materials. In addition, the company is involved in investment advisory; sale of electricity; and operation and management of parking lots and solar power plants, as well as attraction of commercial facility factories. Yoshicon Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.
